recipes.name: Älplermagronen (Alpine macaroni)
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"aelplermagronen-s0","text":"Fry bacon cubes in pot (this pot will be used for everything so choose an appropriately large one).","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s1","text":"Cut onions into half-rings and let them sweat in the same pot. Add some butter if your bacon was not fatty enough.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s2","text":"Peel potatoes and cut them into ~1 cm/half inch cubes.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s3","text":"When the onions have become sufficiently cooked, add potatoes.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s4","text":"Top everything with milk and let the potatoes cook for about 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s5","text":"Add macaroni and the remaining milk to cover everything. Most of the milk will be absorbed by the macaroni.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s6","text":"Shred your cheese.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s7","text":"A minute or two before the macaroni are done, add the shredded cheese into the pot. It should appear a bit too runny in the pot. While cooling it will increase in viscosity quite a bit. If the final texture is not creamy enough, it is most likely due to using the wrong cheese.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s8","text":"Season to taste. (Needs quite a bit of salt). Nutmeg also works well here.","groupId":null},{"id":"aelplermagronen-s9","text":"Serve with apple sauce. Should be eaten together, not as a dessert.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: ~150g medium soft cheese. Appenzeller works best. Gruyère would be my go-to alternative.

recipes.name: Spaghetti aglio e olio
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"aglio-e-olio-s0","text":"Heat a large skillet on medium-high heat, start cooking the pasta.","groupId":null},{"id":"aglio-e-olio-s1","text":"Finely slice or mince the garlic and finely chop the parsley.","groupId":null},{"id":"aglio-e-olio-s2","text":"Add the oil and garlic to the skillet and gently cook it until it's lightly golden brown.","groupId":null},{"id":"aglio-e-olio-s3","text":"Add the red pepper flakes to the skillet and turn down the heat to let its flavor infuse the oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"aglio-e-olio-s4","text":"When the pasta has finished cooking, drain it, and reserve at least around a cup of the cooking water.","groupId":null},{"id":"aglio-e-olio-s5","text":"Now add the drained pasta with some of the cooking water to the skillet and toss vigorously. The starch in the pasta water will help the sauce emulsify and get it to the right consistency.","groupId":null},{"id":"aglio-e-olio-s6","text":"At the very last second add the parsley, to preserve its freshness. Adjust the seasoning to taste if necessary.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Air Fryer Zucchini
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"air-fryer-zucchini-s0","text":"Chop the zucchinis into medium-sized squares","groupId":null},{"id":"air-fryer-zucchini-s1","text":"Put zucchini into a bowl and lightly add olive oil, season salt, garlic powder (optional), and onion powder (optional)","groupId":null},{"id":"air-fryer-zucchini-s2","text":"Cook in air fryer for 8 minutes at 400 F or until crispy.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Apple Pie
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"apple-pie-s0","text":"Peel and cut the apples into 1-2 inch strips","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s1","text":"Put the apples in a bowl and mix in the lemon juice, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cornstarch and let it sit for 15 mins to release water","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s2","text":"Transfer the filling mixture to a sauce pan and reduce the liquid over medium to low heat for around 15 mins, stirring regularly, then turn off the gas","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s3","text":"While the filling is sitting / reducing, start the crust by putting the flour, salt, sugar, and pieces of butter in a food processor","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s4","text":"Run the food processor until it resembles a coarse sand (5-10 seconds) then start dripping in the ice water until the mixture starts to chunk together","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s5","text":"You'll know when it's done if you can pinch the dough with your hand and it sticks together","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s6","text":"Preheat oven to 350°F then start making the pie crust","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s7","text":"Cut the dough in half and roll both halves out with a rolling pin until they are big enough to cover your pie pan (around 9 inch diameter)","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s8","text":"Put the bottom half dough into the pie pan and cut off the excess dough with a knife","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s9","text":"Dump the sauce pan full of the filling into the pie pan and even it out","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s10","text":"Cover the pie filling with the top dough and fold over and tuck in the excess crust","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s11","text":"Use a fork or your fingers to pinch down the top crust to the bottom crust so you don't have air gaps","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s12","text":"Optionally you can now brush on the egg wash to make the crust get a shiny golden brown color when it cooks","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s13","text":"Cut a few slits in the top crust with a knife to give it a nice design and allow for air to release","groupId":null},{"id":"apple-pie-s14","text":"Bake 45 minutes at 350°F or until the crust is brown to your liking and the apples are bubbling inside","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Asian Style Chicken with Sticky Sauce
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s0","text":"Prepare the sauce by mixing the ingredients together in a bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s1","text":"Cut the chicken into bite sized pieces.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s2","text":"Place all-purpose flour in a shallow bowl. Mix in garlic powder as well as salt and pepper, 0.5 tsp each.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s3","text":"Place lightly beaten egg in another shallow bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s4","text":"Coat the chicken in corn flour, dip it in egg and finally coat with seasoned all purpose-flour.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s5","text":"Heat a good amount of oil on a pan to fry the chicken in. The oil should be hot enough so that the chicken sizzles when placed in the pan. You may want to do this in a couple of batches depending on the size of your pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s6","text":"Fry until chicken is cooked and has a nice golden-brownish coating.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s7","text":"Pour out excess oil, put the sauce in and mix to coat the chicken. Or place the chicken in a bowl with kitchen towels and do another batch.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s8","text":"Let the sauce bubble for one or two minutes and you're done.","groupId":null},{"id":"asian-style-chicken-sticky-sauce-s9","text":"Serve with boiled rice.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: Around 14 ounces or 400 grams of chicken breast
Around 5 tbsp of sesame oil for frying the chicken
Chinese rice vinegar or alternatively white wine vinegar

recipes.name: Assam Tea
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"assam-tea-s0","text":"Add 150 ml of water to a small pan and bring it to boil.","groupId":null},{"id":"assam-tea-s1","text":"Then add 2 teaspoons of tea into it and reduce the heat to low.","groupId":null},{"id":"assam-tea-s2","text":"Strain the tea using a tea filter into a cup.","groupId":null},{"id":"assam-tea-s3","text":"Add sugar and milk to taste.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Autumn Soup
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"autumn-soup-s0","text":"Peel and chop squash, potatoes, carrots, and onion, add to oven-safe pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"autumn-soup-s1","text":"Add bullion and enough water to avoid burning (1 cup), place pot in oven (350F) to bake until veggies are soft.","groupId":null},{"id":"autumn-soup-s2","text":"If there is too much stock, don't be scared to pour some down the drain.","groupId":null},{"id":"autumn-soup-s3","text":"Puree (I use electric beaters) while adding the milk.","groupId":null},{"id":"autumn-soup-s4","text":"Add the salt and pepper, as desired.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Baked Mostaccioli
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"baked-mostaccioli-s0","text":"Bring a pot to a boil and cook pasta for 6 minutes (very al dente).","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-mostaccioli-s1","text":"Put pasta and sauce in baking dish(es) and mix well.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-mostaccioli-s2","text":"Cover pasta and sauce generously with grated cheese until you can't see the pasta.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-mostaccioli-s3","text":"Bake at 350°F / 175°C for 20 minutes, or 375°F / 190°C for 15 minutes on convection bake.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: box mostaccioli rigati or penne rigate

recipes.name: Baked pasta with broccoli, boiled eggs and scamorza cheese
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s0","text":"Boil water and add salt (a handful for every liter), put pasta inside.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s1","text":"Boil broccoli and eggs for 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s2","text":"While everything is boiling dice scamorza cheese, prepare a pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s3","text":"Put a layer of béchamel.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s4","text":"Put a layer of pasta.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s5","text":"Put a layer of broccoli, diced scamorza cheese, pepper, salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s6","text":"Go to step 4 and repeat until ingredients end.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s7","text":"Add sage leafs on top (optional).","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s8","text":"Put the pan inside the (preheated) oven at 180°C for 15~20 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-pasta-with-broccoli-s9","text":"End with 5~10 minutes of cooking with the grill function.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Valencian Baked Rice (Arroz al Horno)
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"baked-rice-s0","text":"Preheat the oven to 220°C (428°F), using both upper and lower heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s1","text":"Peel the potato and cut it into 1 cm thick slices. Set aside.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s2","text":"In a clay casserole (oven-safe), heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Brown the pork ribs and pork belly until golden and crispy. Remove and set aside.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s3","text":"In the same oil, lightly fry the potato slices until golden. Remove and set aside.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s4","text":"Sear the blood sausages for a few minutes, being careful not to break them. Remove and set aside.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s5","text":"Stir the sweet paprika into the remaining oil, mixing quickly to avoid burning. Add the crushed tomatoes and cook until the oil separates from the sauce.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s6","text":"Mix in the cooked chickpeas and rice, stirring for a couple of minutes so the rice absorbs the flavors.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s7","text":"Return the pork ribs, pork belly, and potato slices to the casserole, evenly distributing them over the rice. Place the whole garlic head in the center and arrange the blood sausages and tomato slices on top.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s8","text":"Pour the hot broth into the casserole, ensuring it covers all ingredients. Add the saffron threads and adjust the salt if needed.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s9","text":"Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice has absorbed all the broth and is tender.","groupId":null},{"id":"baked-rice-s10","text":"Once done, remove from the oven and let the baked rice rest, covered with a clean cloth, for 5 minutes before serving.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Banana Bread
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"banana-bread-s0","text":"Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C)","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-bread-s1","text":"Mix the wet ingredients (eggs, bananas, butter, sugar) in one bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-bread-s2","text":"Mix the dry ingredients (flour, baking soda/powder, spices, salt) in another bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-bread-s3","text":"Slowly add the wet to the dry while mixing.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-bread-s4","text":"Mix until dry bits of flour are gone.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-bread-s5","text":"Pour into lightly buttered or oiled loaf pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-bread-s6","text":"Bake for around an hour (it's definitely ready when a wooden skewer or chopstick poked inside comes out clean).","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Banana Muffins with Chocolate
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"banana-muffins-with-chocolate-s0","text":"Peel the bananas and mush them together.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-muffins-with-chocolate-s1","text":"Whip the two eggs and mix them with the sugar.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-muffins-with-chocolate-s2","text":"Melt the butter, cut the chocolate into smaller pieces, and whip the eggs.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-muffins-with-chocolate-s3","text":"Pour the butter into the bananas, then add the flour, then the cooking powder, the chocolate, the whipped eggs and sugar, and the optional vanilla sugar; stirring it all the time.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-muffins-with-chocolate-s4","text":"Pour the mass into your muffin dish.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-muffins-with-chocolate-s5","text":"Heat up the oven to 160 °C / 320 °F and bake the muffins for around 20-30 minutes at 170 °C / 340 °F.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Banana and oatmeal cookies
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"banana-oatmeal-cookies-s0","text":"Pre-heat the oven to 180°C (350°F)","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-oatmeal-cookies-s1","text":"Peel the bananas and squash them not too finely in a bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-oatmeal-cookies-s2","text":"Incorporate the oatmeal.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-oatmeal-cookies-s3","text":"Incorporate cinnamon powder and/or honey (optional).","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-oatmeal-cookies-s4","text":"On the oven tray, place parchment paper and form discs of the mix, each around 8 cm (3 in)","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-oatmeal-cookies-s5","text":"Cook with rotating heat for around 20 minutes, until outside becomes golden and slightly crispy.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-oatmeal-cookies-s6","text":"Eat warm or cold. Can be kept a couple of days in a sealed container.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"banana-pancakes-s0","text":"Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and a little bit of salt in a large mixing bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-pancakes-s1","text":"Whisk milk and egg into the flour mixture until no clumps remain in the resulting batter.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-pancakes-s2","text":"Add mashed bananas and mix well.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-pancakes-s3","text":"Add some butter to a medium warm frying pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"banana-pancakes-s4","text":"Make smaller or bigger pancakes, up to you. Wait until tiny air bubbles form on top (2 to 5 minutes), turn and continue frying until the bottom is browned. Repeat. Either eat the pancakes as they get ready or put a plate in a preheated oven (low degree) to keep the ready pancakes warm.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Basic Meatballs
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"basic-meatballs-s0","text":"Preheat oven to 200°C/400F","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-meatballs-s1","text":"In a bowl, combine all ingredients","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-meatballs-s2","text":"Hand form into balls by packing with your hands and then rolling. Set aside on a baking sheet, preferably one with a cooling rack * I prefer large meatballs (larger than a golf ball) and shoot for 16-20 for 2 lbs of meat, but if you prefer smaller meatballs you can opt for as many as 48","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-meatballs-s3","text":"Either halfway through the packing process or after forming all meatballs, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-meatballs-s4","text":"Add 1-2 tbsp of oil to the skillet (enough to evenly coat the skillet), and bring to heat","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-meatballs-s5","text":"Fill the skillet with meatballs, start by browning one face, flip once at after 2-3 minutes, and then remove to the baking sheet after another 2-3 minute. Continue in batches until all meatballs have been browned  It is OK and expected for the meatballs to lose some of their spherical shape at this point  You can skip this step and go straight the oven if you want to cut corners","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-meatballs-s6","text":"Transfer to the oven, and cook until the inside registers 60°C/140F on an instant read thermometer. This should be about 20 minutes for large meatballs (16 per batch), maybe 10 for small (48 per batch)","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-meatballs-s7","text":"Serve with pasta or on a meatball sub","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.description: (I use 2% but doesn't matter too much)

recipes.name: Basic Waffles
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"basic-waffles-s0","text":"Beat the eggs till creamy.","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-waffles-s1","text":"Gradually add all the sugar and the vanilla flavouring.","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-waffles-s2","text":"Melt and then mix in the butter.","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-waffles-s3","text":"Add the baking powder.","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-waffles-s4","text":"Add the milk and flower in alternation. Stir constantly while doing so.","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-waffles-s5","text":"Blend and mix until you got a smooth dough. Use the highest speed of your mixer.","groupId":null},{"id":"basic-waffles-s6","text":"Let the dough rest for a couple of minutes. Turn on & preheat your waffle maker, then pour in the dough. ingredients.name: pcks vanilla sugar or other vanilla flavouring

recipes.name: Batter Pudding
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"batter-pudding-s0","text":"Stir the flour, gradually, into the milk, carefully dissolving all the lumps. Beat the eggs very light, and add them by degrees to the milk and flour. Put in the salt, and stir the whole well together.","groupId":null},{"id":"batter-pudding-s1","text":"Take a very thick pudding-cloth. A square cloth, which when tied up will make the pudding of a round form, is better than a bag. Dip it in boiling water, and flour it.","groupId":null},{"id":"batter-pudding-s2","text":"Pour into it the mixture and tie it up, leaving room for it to swell.","groupId":null},{"id":"batter-pudding-s3","text":"Boil it hard, one hour, and keep it in the pot, till it is time to send it to table.","groupId":null},{"id":"batter-pudding-s4","text":"Serve it up with wine-sauce. Apple Batter Pudding is made by pouring the batter over a dish of apples, pared, cored, and sweetened, either whole or cut in pieces. Bake it, and eat it with butter and sugar.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Three Bean Salad
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"bean-salad-s0","text":"Put dressing ingredients in a large salad bowl an whisk until blended.","groupId":null},{"id":"bean-salad-s1","text":"Empty cans of beans into a colander and rinse under cold water.","groupId":null},{"id":"bean-salad-s2","text":"Chop remaining vegetables and add to dressing.  Add beans and gently stir.","groupId":null},{"id":"bean-salad-s3","text":"Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving, stirring occasionally.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Bebek Mropol
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"bebek-mropol-s0","text":"Heat up a large pot over medium-high heat, and add the duck pieces skin side first to render the fat. Flip and cook until the duck is browned on all sides.","groupId":null},{"id":"bebek-mropol-s1","text":"Add the minced garlic, shallots, and sliced chilies to the pot, and stir-fry for a few minutes until fragrant.","groupId":null},{"id":"bebek-mropol-s2","text":"Pour in the coconut milk, and add the lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, bay leaves, salt, sugar, and tamarind paste. Stir well to combine.","groupId":null},{"id":"bebek-mropol-s3","text":"Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for about 1 hour, or until the duck is tender and the sauce has thickened.","groupId":null},{"id":"bebek-mropol-s4","text":"Serve the Bebek Mprol hot with a side of white rice.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Beef Goulash
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"beef-goulash-s0","text":"Heat up the frying pan and add some oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s1","text":"Cut the potatoes into small pieces and fry them on the frying pan over medium-heat, add some salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s2","text":"Chop the onion.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s3","text":"Cut the beef into small enough pieces and dust with flour.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s4","text":"After about 15 minutes of frying the potatoes, add the onions and beef to the pan and fry for another 10-15 minutes, or until brown.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s5","text":"While the beef, potatoes and onions are frying, cut the carrot and mushrooms, and chop the parsley and cilantro.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s6","text":"Once the beef is brown, add water to the pan, and add the rest of the ingredients, including salt, black pepper and herbs/spices to taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s7","text":"Mix thoroughly, cover the pan with a lid and stew for about 60-80 minutes over low-heat. While it is stewing, you can get back to doing some other things, like watching memes.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-goulash-s8","text":"Remove from stove, serve hot and enjoy with some beer or cider (or your favorite beverage).","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Beef Jerky
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"beef-jerky-s0","text":"Mince or press garlic.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-jerky-s1","text":"Mix all ingredients except beef to make brine.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-jerky-s2","text":"Slice beef into 0.25\" (0.5 cm) thick strips. Small chunks, about 0.75\" (2 cm), of stewing beef may also be used. If possible, cut along the grain of the meat rather than across it. It may be easier to freeze the meat before attempting to cut it, as this will stop the meat pulling and deforming so easily.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-jerky-s3","text":"Marinate meat in overnight, or at least for an hour or two.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-jerky-s4","text":"Place meat on racks and dry in a food dehydrator at 145 °F (63 °C) for 6-8 hours. May be dried in a 150 °F (65 °C) oven with foil-covered racks. In oven, turn meat over 3-4 hours into drying time and reduce temperature to 130 °F (55 °C).","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-jerky-s5","text":"Meat should bend but not break when properly dried.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: beef

recipes.name: Beef Kidney
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"beef-kidney-s0","text":"clean the kidney and remove the fat","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s1","text":"cut the kidney into small chunks (2cm or 0.75\")","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s2","text":"put butter in a casserole dish","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s3","text":"add kidney, parsley, bay leaf, salt, pepper","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s4","text":"brown in the casserole for 10 minutes while stirring (don't burn)","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s5","text":"add 2 glasses of dry white wine","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s6","text":"add half a glass of water so that the mixture is well-bathed","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s7","text":"simmer for 35 minutes","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s8","text":"add about 400g of toasted bread in pieces","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-kidney-s9","text":"simmer for another 10 minutes","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Liver and Onions
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"beef-liver-and-onions-s0","text":"Heat up the pan to medium with oil / animal fat.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-liver-and-onions-s1","text":"Chop up the onions into long pieces or small squares, to your preference.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-liver-and-onions-s2","text":"Put onions in pan. Wait a couple minutes, turn the heat to high, and add the liver. Stir frequently to prevent onions from burning. Cook for about 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-liver-and-onions-s3","text":"If pieces of beef liver are large, cut them into smaller pieces. About half a finger in size is best.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-liver-and-onions-s4","text":"Add other vegetables. (optional)","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-liver-and-onions-s5","text":"Season generously with salt and any seasoning you like. Various spice rubs work well.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Beef Wellington
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"beef-wellington-s0","text":"Season the fillet with salt and black pepper.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s1","text":"With a nicely-oiled pan on high heat, sear the fillet on all sides, including the ends.  For the standard medium-rare beef wellington, do not cook the fillet, just sear it, tough if you want something more cooked than medium-rare, it's wise to give it more heat here.  Put it aside on a plate.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s2","text":"Brush the fillet with yellow mustard immediatly after taking it out of the pan.  This allows the musturd's flavour to be absorbed by the fillet and thus preserve a mildly hot flavor.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s3","text":"Chop the mushrooms. Put them in a food processor. Transfer the purée to a sauté pan that has been heated to medium high heat to cook. Allow the mushrooms to release their moisture; once the moisture has been boiled away take the mushrooms out of pan to cool.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s4","text":"Lay out the slices of ham on plastic wrap and spread the mushroom mixture over the ham.  Place the fillet in the middle.  Wrap the fillet into a tight barrel shape twist the end of the plastic wrap to secure the wrap and the refrigerate the whole thing for 20 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s5","text":"Preheat the oven to 302°F/150°C.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s6","text":"On a lightly floured surface, roll out a sheet of puff pastry to a size that will fit the fillet.  Preserve a little excess pastry. Unwrap the fillet-mushroom-ham from the plastic wrap and place in the middle of the pastry dough.  Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg yolks.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s7","text":"Place the pastry-wrapped thing on a baking tray. Brush the exposed surface again with the beaten eggs. Optionally, score the top of the pastry with a knife, to give it a better presentation.  Scratch the surface of it but don't cut it through.  Season it through with coarse salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"beef-wellington-s8","text":"Bake at 302°F/105°C for 35-42 minutes. The pastry should be nicely golden when done.  Let it rest for about 10 minutes and cut it into 1in/2.54cm-thick slices for presentation.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Belgian pear syrup
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s0","text":"Wash the outside of the fruit with water and cut it in 8 medium sized pieces. You don't have to core or deseed the fruit; everything can go in the pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s1","text":"Place the fruit in a large pan with a thick bottom so you get even heat. I suggest you place the pears on the bottom, since they don't burn as fast. Add the glass of water.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s2","text":"If you are using them, add the dried fruits at this point.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s3","text":"Put the heat as low as possible and let it all slowly stew for 3 hours, stirring every now and then.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s4","text":"At this point, you can boil your glass jars to sterilize them. Place the sterilized jars on a clean, dry towel.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s5","text":"When the fruit is done cooking for 3 hours, grab your sieve or cheese cloth, and place it over a bowl, run your fruit through it until you have extracted all the clear liquid. You can discard the pulp.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s6","text":"Quickly rinse the pot with water until clean and add the fruit liquid back. Place back on the stove.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s7","text":"Add the sugar. Add a bit less sugar if you also used dried fruits.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s8","text":"Cook for another 2 hours. After that, stir every so often, Be careful with the stirring; if you stir too often, it might caramelize too quickly.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s9","text":"After two to two and a half hours, your syrup should be nearly done.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s10","text":"At this point, it's up to you on how thick you want your syrup to be. A good way to test the viscosity is to drop a little bit on a cold plate or on your countertop to see how it is at room temperature.","groupId":null},{"id":"belgian-pear-syrup-s11","text":"When you are happy with the viscosity, pour the syrup into your sterilized jars and immediately seal them.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Bolo do Caco (Caco Bread)
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s0","text":"Peel the sweet potatoes. Cut into large pieces and place in a saucepan.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s1","text":"Cover with water, bring to a boil and cook covered for 20 minutes over 1. medium-high heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s2","text":"Drain the sweet potatoes and mash them. Add salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s3","text":"Mix the yeast and water and let stand for 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s4","text":"Pour the flour into a large salad bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s5","text":"Dig a well in the center and add the mashed sweet potato and yeast.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s6","text":"Knead to obtain a homogeneous and elastic dough.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s7","text":"Let the dough ferment for 3 days in the refrigerator.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s8","text":"After 3 days, divide the dough into 8 to 10 pieces of equal weight on a work surface dusted with flour.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s9","text":"Form balls and flatten them to a thickness of about 1 inch (2,5cm).","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s10","text":"Let them rest for 30 minutes in a warm place, protected from drafts.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s11","text":"Heat a dry pan over medium-high heat and cook the bolos do caco on both sides until a thin and slightly hard crust is formed. Turn them over very regularly.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s12","text":"Then take each bolo do caco with tongs and turn them around on the hot pan to bake the sides.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolo-do-caco-s13","text":"Serve warm or lukewarm with salted butter and parsley.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Bolognese Sauce
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s0","text":"Finely dice the carrots, celery, onion and pancetta, if your blender can handle it you can optionally blend all this to speed it up.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s1","text":"Heat up a large saucepan or dutch oven on medium low heat and put enough olive oil in to cover the bottom of the pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s2","text":"Put in your diced veggies and pancetta and let it slowly sauté for about 10 minutes until everything is fragrant and soft.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s3","text":"If you are using garlic add it here and let it sweat for a minute","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s4","text":"Add in your minced meat and break it up into small clumps about the size of a rice grain with a spoon, keep stiring until all your meat is lightly cooked.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s5","text":"Once all your meat is cooked and looks a bit grey add your wine, add enough to fully deglaze the pan (I usually add a little bit extra for the flavor) stir it through until it has completely evaporated. (If you are using it you can also add the stock at this point)","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s6","text":"Once your pan is somewhat dry you can add the tomato paste to the beef, let it cook for a minute to remove the slight metallic taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s7","text":"Add your canned and peeled tomatoes and use your spoon to break them up, you don't have to be too thorough since they will soften up while the sauce cooks.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s8","text":"add the diced tomatoes, fill the jar your tomatoes came in with water give it a shake and add that to the pot, do the same with your can of peeled tomatoes.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s9","text":"lower your heat to the lowest setting and slightly cover the pan with your lid.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s10","text":"let it simmer for as long as you can wait, preferably at least 4 hours, if it starts getting a bit too dry you can add a bit more water to make sure the sauce doesn't burn.","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s11","text":"Once it's done simmering for as long as you can muster and its nice and thick, the liquid should not come above your meat and should be pretty concentrated","groupId":null},{"id":"bolognese-sauce-s12","text":"You can add your glass of milk, let it simmer for 10 more minutes and serve.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Bread
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"bread-s0","text":"Proof the yeast. To do this warm 0.25 cup water to about bath water heat (110 degrees F, 43 degrees C) add active dry yeast and 1 Tsp sugar. Let sit for about 10 minutes, mixture should at least be doubled in size after waiting.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s1","text":"Combine rest of water, yeast mixture, maple syrup (or other sweetener), salt, and flour in a large mixing bowl and stir. The result will be a sticky, rough dough. Use a spoon to stir until well combined and when it can no longer do the job, knead and turn it in the bowl with your hands.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s2","text":"Lift the dough out and lightly grease the bowl with nonstick spray or olive oil. Cover and let rise for 2 hours at room temperature.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s3","text":"Transfer dough to a lightly floured work surface and knead until dough is elastic. Rule of thumb is 10 minutes of kneading.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s4","text":"Place seam-side down in a lightly greased loaf pan or baking sheet. Loosely cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 45-60 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s5","text":"Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (218 C)* toward the end of the dough resting time and place a metal pan (NOT glass, Pyrex, or ceramic) on the lowest oven rack. Also have 1 cup of hot water ready.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s6","text":"When the oven is preheated, slash the bread 2 or 3 times with a knife, making a cut about 0.5-inch deep.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s7","text":"Place in oven on middle rack. Then carefully pour hot water into the shallow pan on the rack beneath. Expect it to bubble and steam; then close oven door quickly.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s8","text":"Bake the bread for 26 to 35 minutes, or until deep golden brown and risen. Tapping the top of the loaf should produce a hollow sound.","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s9","text":"Remove the bread from the oven and let rest in the pan for 5 minutes. Then carefully remove from pan and transfer to a cooling rack to cool. Let it cool completely before slicing for best results (otherwise it can be doughy in the middle).","groupId":null},{"id":"bread-s10","text":"Store leftovers in a plastic bag at room temperature for up to a few days. Transfer to freezer for longer term storage.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Breakfast Wrap

You may well find that manually stirring in the flour yields better results.","groupId":null},{"id":"butter-cake-s3","text":"Beat or stir in the remainder of the flour until just incorporated.","groupId":null},{"id":"butter-cake-s4","text":"(optional) Separate approximately one-third of the batter and mix in with it cocoa powder.","groupId":null},{"id":"butter-cake-s5","text":"To make the meringue, beat egg whites at high speed while gradually adding sugar until firm peaks form.","groupId":null},{"id":"butter-cake-s6","text":"Fold the meringue into the batter. recipes.name: Garam Masala
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"garam-masala-s0","text":"Star anise and Mace are normally not added to Garam masala. They are added specially if someone is making Biriyani.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s1","text":"Cloves will make the masala really hot. So make sure to add only as much as you want to eat.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s2","text":"Too much Mace makes the masala quite bitter. So make sure you do not add more than what has been recommended. The amount of other spices can be changed according to taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s3","text":"Wash all the dry spices really well.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s4","text":"If you live in a place which is very sunny, sun dry your washed spices for about 1 day. If not then on a frying pan with a heavy bottom, place all the spices and dry roast them until aromatic.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s5","text":"Cool the dry spices and put them into a mixer. Mix thoroughly.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s6","text":"Sieve the powder and add the larger pieces into the mixer once again and mix it again until everything turns into a fine powder. This step might need to be repeated a few times.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s7","text":"The resulting mixture is garam masala. Store it in airtight glass jars.","groupId":null},{"id":"garam-masala-s8","text":"You can store this mixture for about 0.667 months in a cool dry place.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Carbonara
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"carbonara-s0","text":"Crack the eggs in a bowl but only add the yolks. Add a generous amount of your preferred grated cheese (Pecorino or Parmigiano) around 35g (you can optionally add a dash of black pepper).","groupId":null},{"id":"carbonara-s1","text":"Fill a pot with water and salt it less than typical pasta water. When it boils, cook the pasta one minute less than advised.","groupId":null},{"id":"carbonara-s2","text":"Fry the preferred pork (Guanciale or Smoked Pancetta) in an iron or nonstick pan (if using a different kind of pan add a dash of extra virgin olive oil) on low to medium heat until the sides are crisp but the insides are chewy.","groupId":null},{"id":"carbonara-s3","text":"While everything is being cooked and fried, beat the eggs manually using a fork until everything is entirely liquid. Keep moving and stirring to fully incorporate the eggs. Add guanciale and as many fats remaining in the pan as you want. recipes.name: Challah Bread

recipes.name: Cheese
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"cheese-s0","text":"Pour the milk and the salt into a pot, stir it well, and heat it up to 35°C. Once the temperature has been reached, add the rennet and stir well. Let it cook until it solidifies (about 1 and a half hours), then cut in 1x1cm squares. Let it rest for half an hour. Pour the cheese into the cheesecloth and il drip until it has completely separated from the liquid part (whey). Place the cheese into the recipient. Cover both sides of the cheese with coarse salt, repeat this operation twice, waiting 1 hour between two saltings. Store in the fridge.","groupId":"cheese-dg0"},{"id":"cheese-s1","text":"Store the cheese in a chill place (around 12°C). Every day of aging, flip the cheese upside-down. For the first two weeks, also cover it with oil and vinegar every day.","groupId":"cheese-dg1"}],"groups":[{"id":"cheese-dg0","title":"Preparation"},{"id":"cheese-dg1","title":"Aging (optional)"}]}

recipes.name: Classic béchamel sauce
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"classic-bechamel-sauce-s0","text":"Put your butter in your pot and let is slowly melt on medium to low heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"classic-bechamel-sauce-s1","text":"Once the butter is fully melted add the flour and stir it in to make a roux.","groupId":null},{"id":"classic-bechamel-sauce-s2","text":"Keep stiring your roux on medium low heat until it gets lightly golden brown and starts melling a bit nutty.","groupId":null},{"id":"classic-bechamel-sauce-s3","text":"Add about a glass of your whole milk and stir until combined, repeat this process until you have a thick sauce in your pan and new milk you add easily combines. recipes.name: Coriander Chicken
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"coriander-chicken-s0","text":"Cut the boneless chicken into small bite sized pieces.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s1","text":"In a mixer, put 250g coriander leaves, 0.667 green chillies, 250g yoghurt, 20g ginger, 0.9 cloves of garlic, 2 medium sized onions and mix well.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s2","text":"Add the green chillies according to your taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s3","text":"Pour half of the mixture from step 2 into a bowl and mix it thoroughly with the chicken.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s4","text":"Into this chicken mixture add 1 tbsp Garam Masala and salt to taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s5","text":"Keep the resulting marinated chicken aside for about 30 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s6","text":"In a frying pan add 3 tbsp of either mustard oil or sunflower oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s7","text":"Once the oil is hot, add 1 tbsp sugar and cook until the sugar melts into the oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s8","text":"Add 0.667 cardamom pods, 1 small cinnamon stick, and 1 bayleaf into the hot oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s9","text":"Simmer for about 1 minute, then lower the heat to medium.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s10","text":"On medium heat, add the marinated chicken mixture and cook till oil starts separating from the chicken.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s11","text":"Add salt to taste and keep stirring the chicken to make sure it does not burn or stick to the bottom of the pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s12","text":"Once the oil separates, add the remaining mixture which was left behind after step 4.","groupId":null},{"id":"coriander-chicken-s13","text":"Stir until it has a thick consistency. recipes.name: Country Crisp Cereals
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s0","text":"Preheat the oven at 120°C.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s1","text":"Prepare the cooking support with for example, a parchment paper on a cooking plate.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s2","text":"Mix the sugar and the water, until the sugar dissolves.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s3","text":"In a large container (like a salad bowl) introduce the Flour, the Oat Flakes, and the Crushed Hazelnuts (and optionally the Vanilla Extract), and mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s4","text":"Introduce in the previous mixture, the Sugar Syrup and the Oil, and mix again.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s5","text":"Deposit the paste obtained on the cooking plate without exceeding 2 cm in height.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s6","text":"Bake the mixture in the 120°C oven until it becomes hard (in approximately 2 hours)","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s7","text":"Break the hardened mixture to obtain cereals.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-crisp-cereals-s8","text":"Add if you want some broken chocolate (or chocolate chips) in the cereals, or anything you want.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Country Breakfast Skillet
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"country-skillet-s0","text":"Cut the bacon into pieces and fry it on a pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s1","text":"Cut the potatoes into small cubes.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s2","text":"After frying the bacon, set aside and use the bacon grease to fry the potatoes over medium/medium-low heat for about 20 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s3","text":"Add some salt and paprika to the potatoes, mix well and cook for another ten minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s4","text":"Cut the onions and add them to the frying pan. Cook for about five minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s5","text":"If you decide to add some vegetables, like mushrooms or peppers, add them now.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s6","text":"Now, there are two ways you can cook the eggs.  Beat the eggs in a bowl and the pour them onto the pan. * Or just crack the eggs directly on the mix in the pan and mix everything thoroughly.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s7","text":"Cut the cheese into small slices and add it.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s8","text":"Cook for a couple of minutes more, until eggs are cooked enough. Don't let the eggs dry (unless that's the way you like your eggs ¯\\\\_(ツ)\\_/¯).","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s9","text":"For the final touch, chop the parsley (or whatever other spices/herbs you decided to use) and add it on top.","groupId":null},{"id":"country-skillet-s10","text":"Serve hot and add some freshly ground pepper. \\*Personally, I prefer to beat the eggs first in a bowl before adding them to the frying pan.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Crab salad

recipes.name: Cream Cheese

recipes.name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s0","text":"Peel and cut the potatoes into medium sized pieces.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s1","text":"Put the potatoes in a pot with some water so that it covers the potatoes and boil them for about 20-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are soft.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s2","text":"About ten minutes before removing the potatoes from the boiling water, cut the bacon into little pieces and fry it.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s3","text":"Warm up the milk and mayonnaise.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s4","text":"Shred the cheese.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s5","text":"When the potatoes are done, remove all water from the pot, add the warm milk and mayonnaise mix, add some butter, and mash with a potato masher or a blender.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s6","text":"Add some salt, black pepper and garlic powder to taste and continue mashing the mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s7","text":"Once the mix is somewhat homogeneous and the potatoes are properly mashed, add the shredded cheese and fried bacon and mix a little.","groupId":null},{"id":"creamy-mashed-potatoes-s8","text":"Serve and top with chopped green onions.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Crème brûlée
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"creme-brulee-s0","text":"Mix cream, milk and yolks.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s1","text":"Add sugar, vanilla and lemon.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s2","text":"Let rest for at least 30 min (optionally over night)","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s3","text":"Pour into 4-6 fireproof ramekins.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s4","text":"Pre-heat oven to 150°C and put the grease pan on the middle rail.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s5","text":"Put the ramekins onto the grease pan and fill it with boiling water.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s6","text":"Let the crème cook for 55 min.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s7","text":"Let the ramekins cool down to room temperature and put them in the fridge for at least 2 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s8","text":"Spread a teaspoon of sugar onto each ramekin.","groupId":null},{"id":"creme-brulee-s9","text":"Use a blowtorch to flambé the sugar. Alternatively the grill of your oven may work too.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Croque-monsieur bites
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"croque-monsieur-s0","text":"Prepare the béchamel: melt the butter in a heavy-bottomed saucepan.","groupId":null},{"id":"croque-monsieur-s1","text":"As soon as it foams, sprinkle it with flour, salt, pepper, add a pinch of nutmeg, mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"croque-monsieur-s2","text":"Then pour in the milk, little by little (especially not all at once), stirring with a whisk each time, until the sauce thickens.","groupId":null},{"id":"croque-monsieur-s3","text":"Turn on the oven on th. 0.033°, take the baking sheet out of the oven and line it with aluminum foil.","groupId":null},{"id":"croque-monsieur-s4","text":"Spread 6 slices of bread in front of you, spread them with a little mustard, add a layer of béchamel, 1 slice of ham folded in 4, grated cheese, a layer of béchamel, put the other 6 slices of bread on the on top, add a thin layer of béchamel and distribute the rest of the grated cheese.","groupId":null},{"id":"croque-monsieur-s5","text":"Arrange the croque-monsieur on the baking sheet and put them in the oven for about 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"croque-monsieur-s6","text":"You can place them under the broiler for 3-4 minutes at the end.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Shortcrust pastry
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"shortcrust-pastry-s0","text":"Cut the butter in slices, put it in a large bowl and leave it at room temperature until it's easy to knead.","groupId":null},{"id":"shortcrust-pastry-s1","text":"Add the powdered sugar and knead until uniform. From now on, pay attention to knead fast enough so that the butter doesn't melt. If it does, place the dough in the fridge for 15-30 minutes before going on.","groupId":null},{"id":"shortcrust-pastry-s2","text":"Add the eggs and knead. It's not necessary that the dough is perfectly uniform.","groupId":null},{"id":"shortcrust-pastry-s3","text":"Add all the flour and knead. Don't knead too much after adding the flour, or the dough won't reach its typical crumbliness. The dough is ready when it's uniform and the surface cracks when you bend it.","groupId":null},{"id":"shortcrust-pastry-s4","text":"Roll out the dough on baking paper. Don't make it too thin: it's not supposed to rise, so it would burn during cooking.","groupId":null},{"id":"shortcrust-pastry-s5","text":"Keep in the fridge for 15-30 minutes before use.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Crostata
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"crostata-s0","text":"Set aside about 0.167 of the shortcrust pastry and roll out the remaining so that it is slightly larger than the tray.","groupId":null},{"id":"crostata-s1","text":"Place rolled shortcrust pastry in a baking mold and arrange the border along those of the mold, so that the pastry can contain jam.","groupId":null},{"id":"crostata-s2","text":"Pour the jam in the shortcrust pastry \"container\" you just created and spread it with a spoon.","groupId":null},{"id":"crostata-s3","text":"Use the pastry you set aside to create rolls and place them in a criss-cross pattern all over the surface. Push them through the jam to the bottom.","groupId":null},{"id":"crostata-s4","text":"Preheat the oven to 180 °C.","groupId":null},{"id":"crostata-s5","text":"Cook in the oven for about 45 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"crostata-s6","text":"Let the cake cool down to room temperature before removing from the mold, otherwise it will easily break.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Cuca "Italiana"
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"cuca-italiana-s0","text":"Add the sifted flour, the nutmeg and a pinch of salt into a bowl. In another one, add the sugar, the warm water, the fat of choice, the yeast and the vanilla essence.","groupId":null},{"id":"cuca-italiana-s1","text":"Unite both mixes and knead it until an homogenous dough forms. Put it in a properly floured and greased baking tray that you would use for baking bread, or a tall, round tray for cake.","groupId":null},{"id":"cuca-italiana-s2","text":"Prepare the \"farofa\" mixing the sugar, the flour, the fat and the vanilla essence with your fingertips, until they form crumbles. Now put the \"farofa\" over the dough, cover it with a cloth and leave it to rest for 2 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"cuca-italiana-s3","text":"Then, bake it at a pre-heated 180C (356F) oven for 40 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"cuca-italiana-s4","text":"Have it with fruit jam (grape is my favourite) or dulce de leche, and some coffee.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"dou-sha-bao-s0","text":"24h after soaking, boil the beans during 5 minutes and rince to clean up impurities.","groupId":null},{"id":"dou-sha-bao-s1","text":"Bring back the beans to simmering point during 1h15h. Stir continuously to dry up the paste during around 10 minutes and let it cool.","groupId":null},{"id":"dou-sha-bao-s4","text":"In a salad bowl, stir the flour, the rest of sugar (~ 50g / 1.7oz), a pinch of salt, the baking powder and baker's yeast.","groupId":null},{"id":"dou-sha-bao-s5","text":"Knead the bun paste during 5 minutes then incorporate the oil, knead again during 2 minutes. Shape a bowl and let it for 1 hour.","groupId":null},{"id":"dou-sha-bao-s6","text":"Shape 6 balls with red beans paste.","groupId":null},{"id":"dou-sha-bao-s7","text":"Press the rested bun paste to remove the gas and knea it up for 1 minute.","groupId":null},{"id":"dou-sha-bao-s8","text":"Sprinkle flour on working plan and make a sausage shape. recipes.name: Dulce de Leche
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"dulce-de-leche-s0","text":"Heat all ingredients in a pan (with the marbles, if you want,) on a medium-heat stove, constantly mixing with a wooden spoon.","groupId":null},{"id":"dulce-de-leche-s1","text":"Once the sugar dissolves, set heat to very low, and keep mixing once in a while for approximately two hours. It should not boil, if it happens, set it aside, keep mixing and once the temperature lowers put it back on the heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"dulce-de-leche-s2","text":"Once the preparation gets thicker, be more careful and mix it more frequently so that it does not stick (and burn) and lumps do not form.","groupId":null},{"id":"dulce-de-leche-s3","text":"Once you get a consistency similar to that of a custard, set it aside and keep mixing for 10 minutes, until it gets cold and thickens a bit more. recipes.name: Egg Roll in a Bowl

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"eggs-benedict-s0","text":"Blend Yolks and Lemon Juice: In a blender, blend the yolks and lemon juice to create the base for the hollandaise sauce. This can optionally be done in a double boiler on a gentle simmer with whisking instead of blending to reduce curdling.","groupId":null},{"id":"eggs-benedict-s1","text":"Drizzle Butter: Slowly pour in the melted butter while blending. The sauce should thicken and become creamy. If it becomes too viscous, add a little warm water or lemon juice to thin it out.","groupId":null},{"id":"eggs-benedict-s2","text":"Season Sauce: Season to taste with cayenne pepper or hot sauce.","groupId":null},{"id":"eggs-benedict-s3","text":"Heat Water to Simmer: Prepare a large saucepan with at least four inches of water and bring it to a gentle simmer. Add the vinegar to help the egg whites set.","groupId":null},{"id":"eggs-benedict-s4","text":"Poach Eggs 3-4 Minutes: Gently slide the eggs into the simmering water. It helps to crack the eggs into a small bowl or ladle, bring the vessel to the surface of the water, and then drop the egg in that way. While cooking, take a spoon and stir the water into a little whirlpool; this can help displace the excess egg whites, giving the poached eggs a cleaner, firmer appearance. Cook for 3-4 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"eggs-benedict-s5","text":"Remove Eggs: Remove the eggs with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain.","groupId":null},{"id":"eggs-benedict-s6","text":"Toast Muffins: Halve the muffins and toast them. Optionally butter both halves. recipes.name: French Toast
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"french-toast-s0","text":"Butter up a frying pan and set it on the burner with low-medium heat.(May need to add more butter in-between slices)","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s1","text":"Take your two eggs and crack them into a bowl together.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s2","text":"Pour milk in the bowl with the eggs.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s3","text":"Break the yolks and stir the eggs and milk well with a beater until it's a smooth, yellow liquid.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s4","text":"Dip one side of bread into the bowl, making sure the liquid gets into all of the surface area of that side.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s5","text":"Immediately bring the side back up and scrape off any access liquid on the side with a butter knife.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s6","text":"Repeat steps 5-6, but for the other side of the bread.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s7","text":"Drop into the hot pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s8","text":"Cook both sides until golden brown, then plop onto a plate.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s9","text":"Repeat steps 5 to 9 until you have cooked all of your bread.","groupId":null},{"id":"french-toast-s10","text":"Drench french toast stack in Maple syrup (Optional)","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Fried Anglerfish fillet
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s0","text":"Turn the creature on its back. With a sharp and preferably short-bladed knife make an incision from the anus to just between the two small fins under the head. This is best done by inserting the knife blade tip facing up while putting force upwards and moving towards the head, letting gravity do the work. This helps to avoid puncturing the organs.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s1","text":"Remove the organs. Gently pull and cut the membrane that connects each to the rest of the body.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s2","text":"Make an incision around the mouth (the hard 'lips'), turn the fish around and do the same to that side.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s3","text":"Start to slowly but firmly pull back the skin cutting whenever there is resistance as you make your way towards the tail.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s4","text":"Once you have removed the skin, flip it back onto its back and cut off the thin flabs of meat of its underside and fins from the body. At this point there should be a clear distinction between the body and the larger head. Behead the animal.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s5","text":"With a filleting knife, fillet the meat from the backbone and remove the tail.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s6","text":"You should be left with 2 long strips of meat. Cut each in half.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s7","text":"In a pan on medium heat, melt a good amount of butter and place the fillets inside. The goal here is to sear the meat to get that light crust. Flip until all sides have turned the 'golden brown' color.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg1"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s8","text":"Add the herbs, just enough to cover the fillets, salt and pepper too if desired and cover with the lid on low heat until fully cooked. Time here varies but it can be anywhere between 5-10 minutes.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg1"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-s9","text":"Enjoy. This goes well with steamed vegetables. Or potatoes to soak up the butter.","groupId":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg1"}],"groups":[{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg0","title":"Preparing the fish"},{"id":"fried-anglerfish-fillet-dg1","title":"Cooking"}]}

recipes.name: Granita
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"granita-s0","text":"Squeeze the lemons. Remove the seeds, but keep both juice and pulp.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s1","text":"Put in a pot the sugar, 175 g of lemon juice and pulp, and 300 ml of water. For the freezing to work as expected, it's important that you don't alter the proportions.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s2","text":"Boil for 10 minutes. You should obtain a syrup with fibers floating in it: if you see pieces bigger than a few millimeters, get rid of them with a blender.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s3","text":"Add 700 ml of water and stir.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s4","text":"Wait for the solution to cool down to room temperature.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s5","text":"Pour it in a container that can be frozen. Plastic ones are usually a good choice, whereas glass ones are often cracked by the increase in water volume.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s6","text":"Put it in the freezer.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s7","text":"Now, for the most boring part: you must prevent the separation of the ingredients due to the freezing process, and the formation of one huge ice block. To do so, every 2 hours you must stir vigorously with a fork (if you need, after the first 6 hours you can usually decrease to once every 4 hours). Take some special cares: _stir even if you don't see any ice yet_: there may already be small crystals if you find any ice block, make sure to break them down don't worry if the ice melts when you stir: the water stays cold and will freeze again fast enough","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s8","text":"Depending on the temperature, the whole thing may take much time to freeze: it's not unusual for it to require up to 20 hours. That's expected and depends also on the amount of sugar and fruit. Granita is ready when in the container there are only ice crystals: no liquid water and no ice blocks. You can then use a spoon to serve in small cups.","groupId":null},{"id":"granita-s9","text":"If you don't consume all granita at once, it may freeze to a block. If that happens, just scratch it with the spoon or break it with a fork. Granita is traditionally prepared with lemons, but you can replace them with any other fruit (the riper, the better), provided you peel it. If you do so, you will need to cook it longer and blend with a blender: the flavour must be released to the water and the sugar. You may also want to use a little less sugar, but don't reduce it too much, or you will get solid ice instead of granita.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

Cook for another 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-sriracha-chicken-thighs-s5","text":"Place chicken thighs on baking tray (or just use skillet if using a cast-iron skillet). Drizzle the sriracha sauce on both sides of the chicken, coating it. You do not have to use all of it.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-sriracha-chicken-thighs-s6","text":"Bake chicken thighs for 15 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-sriracha-chicken-thighs-s7","text":"Test chicken for doneness. Chicken should reach internal temperature of 165°F.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-sriracha-chicken-thighs-s8","text":"If chicken is near done (or done), you can baste a second time with the remaining sauce (you can make more sauce if you need) and return to oven for 5 more minutes. Do not worry about overcooking; chicken thighs are difficult to overcook.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-sriracha-chicken-thighs-s9","text":"When chicken is done, let cool for a few minutes and garnish with sesame seeds before serving.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Honey Vanilla Ice Cream
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s0","text":"Add milk and sugar to medium sized bowl and mix until dissolved.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s1","text":"Add heavy cream and vanilla extract and mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s2","text":"Stir in honey.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s3","text":"Chill in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s4","text":"Add to ice cream maker and let it go for 30 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s5","text":"Swiftly remove from ice cream maker (I use a silicone spatula as it allows for sides to be scraped down) and put into container.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s6","text":"Freeze ice cream overnight - a few hours will do in a pinch but overnight is better.","groupId":null},{"id":"honey-vanilla-ice-cream-s7","text":"Scoop out of container and serve! Goes great with honey cake.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Hummus
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"hummus-s0","text":"Drain and rinse the garbanzo beans.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s1","text":"Place garbanzo beans in a small saucepan or pot, add 1 teaspoon baking soda (this alters the pH to encourage the beans to break down and shed their skins), and cover with a few inches of water. Bring to a boil and cook for 20 minutes, until the skins begin to fall off and the beans look overcooked/mushy. You may need to reduce the heat after a few minutes to prevent boil-overs.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s2","text":"While the garbanzo beans are boiling, combine the garlic and lemon juice with 0.25 teaspoon salt in the workbowl of your food processor. Pulse until a fine, uniform consistency is achieved. You may need to scrape down the top and sides of the bowl to ensure the garlic is chopped finely enough. Leave the mixture for at least 10 minutes for the raw garlic taste to mellow.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s3","text":"After 20 minutes of boiling, drain the garbanzo beans and their skins in a mesh strainer, then rinse for at least 30 seconds with cold water to remove any lingering taste from the baking soda.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s4","text":"Add the tahini to the food processor. Blend until creamy. Scrape down the sides and bottom of the bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s5","text":"While the food processor is running on \"high,\" slowly drizzle in two tablespoons of ice-cold water. Continue to run on high, scraping down the bowl as necessary (1-3 times), until the mixture has enough air worked into it that it lightens in color and thickens in texture substantially.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s6","text":"Scrape down the bowl again, then add the garbanzo beans and cumin (and za'atar, if you have it). Pulse a few times, then set the food processor to high again. Drizzle in 1 tablespoon of olive oil, as slowly as you can manage.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s7","text":"Continue to process the hummus on high for at least one minute longer, up to three minutes longer if it hasn't become smooth enough yet. You can make the hummus thinner at this point by slowly adding ice water a teaspoon at a time while processing on high. Taste the hummus at this point to determine if it needs more lemon juice or more salt for flavor.","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s8","text":"Transfer the hummus into a serving bowl and smooth out the surface with the back of a spoon, creating swirls or indentations for olive oil as desired. Top with additional olive oil and optionally finely chopped fresh parsley, more za'atar, or a sprinkling of sumac (a spice mixture) or dukkah (a seed mixture).","groupId":null},{"id":"hummus-s9","text":"Serve immediately or transfer to an airtight container and store in the refrigerator for up to one week.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Italian Bread
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"italian-bread-s0","text":"Follow directions on the packet to activate yeast in a bowl large enough for mixing the dough","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s1","text":"Add enough water for a total of 400g or 1 0.75 cups (i.e. add 400g minus however much water was used to activate the yeast)","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s2","text":"Optionally add 12g or 2 tsp salt (Unsalted bread is normal in Central Italy, but it's an acquired taste)","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s3","text":"Slowly mix in flour until it forms a dough that will be easy to work with and not overly sticky. Make sure there are no wet or dry pockets in the dough.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s4","text":"Cover and let rest for 15 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s5","text":"Knead the dough and let it rise covered for 1 hour in a warm place until doubled in size.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s6","text":"Split the dough in half and shape it into two loaves. Make sure the seams are at the bottom.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s7","text":"Place the loaves on a lightly greased baking sheet and let it rise covered for 1 hour in a warm place until doubled in size.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s8","text":"Make sure the oven is preheated to 200°C (400°F) before the resting period is over.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s9","text":"Score the loaves and place the baking sheet in the oven.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s10","text":"Bake for 25-30 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-bread-s11","text":"Let cool for 15 minutes before serving.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Italian Mulled Wine
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"italian-mulled-wine-s0","text":"Pour the wine into a stock pot and turn the gas on medium high","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-mulled-wine-s1","text":"Crush all the \"Crushed Ingredients\" in a mortar and pestle","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-mulled-wine-s2","text":"Peel and juice the orange and lemon (toss the peels and juice into the wine but not the white pith)","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-mulled-wine-s3","text":"When the wine is up to a simmer, immediately bring the gas down to low and pour in all the rest of the ingredients","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-mulled-wine-s4","text":"Cook on low for at least 15 minutes to infuse the flavors","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-mulled-wine-s5","text":"Keep the flame on low so the wine stays warm and continues to infuse, but doesn't bubble / burn off the alcohol","groupId":null},{"id":"italian-mulled-wine-s6","text":"Feel free to double the recipe or scale any of these ingredients up or down to suite your taste","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Jam
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"jam-s0","text":"Cut the fruit in small pieces and place it in a pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"jam-s1","text":"Cook on the stove, on low fire. Stir very often so that the fruit doesn't burn.","groupId":null},{"id":"jam-s2","text":"As soon as some juice collects on the bottom of the pot, add sugar and stir until it is no longer visible.","groupId":null},{"id":"jam-s3","text":"Keep the pot on low fire, stirring often and in particular the bottom, which will otherwise burn very easily.","groupId":null},{"id":"jam-s4","text":"Jam _must boil_ for _at least 2 hours_. This is necessary to inactivate botulinum spores that may be present in the fruit, which could otherwise produce deadly toxins.","groupId":null},{"id":"jam-s5","text":"If fruit pieces are still visible, you may blend them.","groupId":null},{"id":"jam-s6","text":"Pour boiling-hot jam in glass jars and close them immediately. They will go vacuum in a few minutes: you can then store your jam for many months.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Ketchup
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"ketchup-s0","text":"Simmer together tomatoes and onion for 20 to 30 minutes; press through a sieve.","groupId":null},{"id":"ketchup-s1","text":"Put the cinnamon, cloves, and garlic loosely in a clean, thin, white cloth; tie top tightly; add to vinegar and simmer 30 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"ketchup-s2","text":"Remove spice bag.","groupId":null},{"id":"ketchup-s3","text":"Boil tomato mixture rapidly until you have but one-half the original amount.","groupId":null},{"id":"ketchup-s4","text":"Stir frequently to prevent sticking.","groupId":null},{"id":"ketchup-s5","text":"Add spiced vinegar, sugar, salt, paprika, and cayenne pepper to tomato mixture.","groupId":null},{"id":"ketchup-s6","text":"Boil rapidly, stirring constantly, about 10 minutes or until slightly thickened.","groupId":null},{"id":"ketchup-s7","text":"Pour into hot, sterile jars, fill jars to top, and seal.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Kettle Corn
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"kettlecorn-s0","text":"Add oil into your saucepan and 3 popcorn kernels.","groupId":null},{"id":"kettlecorn-s1","text":"Cover with lid and set stove to medium-high heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"kettlecorn-s2","text":"Once all 3 kernels pop, add in the rest of your kernels and shake to coat in oil. Pour sugar directly onto the kernels.","groupId":null},{"id":"kettlecorn-s3","text":"Shake the pot for 3 seconds, rest for 3 seconds, and repeat till the kernels start to pop steadily. Depending on your stove, you may need to lift the pot to shake.","groupId":null},{"id":"kettlecorn-s4","text":"Once kernels start popping, shake pot every 1-2 seconds.","groupId":null},{"id":"kettlecorn-s5","text":"Important. Once you no longer hear pops for about 3 seconds, immediately transfer into a bowl to avoid burning.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Kropsua (Finnish Baked Pancake)
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"kropsua-s0","text":"Set oven to preheat 400 degrees F.","groupId":null},{"id":"kropsua-s1","text":"While oven is heating up, mix dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl: flour, sugar, and salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"kropsua-s2","text":"Add milk and eggs to dry ingredients and mix with a hand mixer.","groupId":null},{"id":"kropsua-s3","text":"Once the oven has reached 400F, add one stick of butter into a 9x13 inch glass baking pan, then place it in the oven for a few minutes until the butter has completely melted. Avoid burning the butter by leaving it in the oven too long.","groupId":null},{"id":"kropsua-s4","text":"Using heavy oven mitts, remove pan from oven and pour batter into hot pan containing melted butter.","groupId":null},{"id":"kropsua-s5","text":"Bake for 40 minutes or until the pancake puffs up and is nicely browned.","groupId":null},{"id":"kropsua-s6","text":"Remove from oven and sprinkle additional small amount of nutmeg over the top of of your kropsua.","groupId":null},{"id":"kropsua-s7","text":"To serve, cut the pancake into squares. Top with maple syrup and serve immediately.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Kvass
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"kvass-s0","text":"Bring 1 L of water in a pot to a boil.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s1","text":"Burn black bread in a toaster or in an oven until it is thoroughly scorched to blackness on the outside.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s2","text":"Once the water has come to boil, remove off heat. Add burned black bread, a handful of raisins, a few slices of lemon, and coffee beans to the pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s3","text":"Leave contents of the pot to cool down to room temperature.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s4","text":"Filter out everything from the pot through a strainer, and pour contents into a separate, sterilized container. Add sugar and yeast into the container, and stir until sugar is dissolved. This starts the fermentation process. The amount of sugar in this recipe should yield 1.0%-2.5% alcohol by total volume at the end of the fermentation process.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s5","text":"Add rest of raisins, and non-citrus fruits of your choice. The fruits will positively impact flavour of the final product.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s6","text":"If mixture is not already in a mason jar, pour the mixture into a sterile mason jar, and seal the lid. Place the jar in a warm place (26-30°C; 79-86°F), and let it ferment for a week, or until it stops bubbling.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s7","text":"Remove all raisins and fruits from the jar.","groupId":null},{"id":"kvass-s8","text":"Squeeze lemon juice from lemons into the mixture. You may drink the now-complete kvass right away, or refrigerate it before drinking.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Lamb Biriyani

Grind the ginger and garlic into a paste.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s2","text":"For the green chilli slice it midway to maintain it in one piece.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s3","text":"In a big pot, Add 30 ml of neutral oil and toast the spices for 30 sec on medium heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s4","text":"Add the onions and saute for around 3 min.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s5","text":"Add the tomatoes, ginger and garlic paste and saute for another 3 min.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s6","text":"Add the mutton/ lamb and 2 cups (500ml) of water. Add one Tbsp of salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s7","text":"Turn the heat up to high and add the green chilli, turmeric powder, chilli powder and 2 Tbsp of salt and let the mutton cook for about 40 -50 min.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s8","text":"Ensure that the pot does not run out of water and top up with more if required.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s9","text":"Add about 2 cups of water or to about 800 gm of water in the pot while accounting for water left in the pot (1:2 ratio of rice to water).","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s10","text":"Once boiling again, Add the rice, Garam Masala and Lemon juice / Vinegar to the pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s11","text":"Once 80% of the standing water has evaporated, Turn to the heat down to as low as possible and check the salt and spice levels and add more as required.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s12","text":"Now with a lid on, let the pot simmer for another 10 mins.","groupId":null},{"id":"lamb-biriyani-s13","text":"Serve with onion raitha and boiled Eggs and Garnish with coriander or mint sprigs. recipes.name: Lemon and oregano chicken traybake

Then put the roasting tray into the oven for 20 minutes, or however long until the potatoes start to crisp.","groupId":null},{"id":"lemon-and-oregano-chicken-traybake-s1","text":"In a separate, temporary, tray place the chicken thighs and season them.
