recipes.name: Lemon Pudding
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"lemon-pudding-s0","text":"Grate the yellow part of the rind of a small lemon. Then cut the lemon in half, and squeeze the juice into the plate that contains the grated rind, carefully taking out all the seeds. Mix the juice and rind together.","groupId":null},{"id":"lemon-pudding-s1","text":"Put a quarter of a pound of powdered white sugar into a deep earthen pan, and cut up in it a quarter of a pound of the best fresh butter. If the weather is very cold, set the pan near the fire, for a few minutes, to soften the butter, but do not allow it to melt or it will be heavy. Stir the butter and sugar together, with a stick or wooden spoon, till it is perfectly light and of the consistence of cream.","groupId":null},{"id":"lemon-pudding-s2","text":"Put the eggs in a shallow broad pan, and beat them with an egg-beater or rods, till they are quite smooth, and as thick as a boiled custard. Then stir the eggs, gradually, into the pan of butter and sugar. Add the liquor and rose water by degrees, and then stir in, gradually, the juice and grated rind of the lemon. Stir the whole very hard, after all the ingredients are in.","groupId":null},{"id":"lemon-pudding-s3","text":"Have ready a puff-paste made of five ounces of sifted flour, and a quarter of a pound of fresh butter. The paste must be made with as little water as possible. Roll it out in a circular sheet, thin in the centre, and thicker towards the edges, and just large enough to cover the bottom, sides, and edges of a soup-plate. Butter the soup-plate very well, and lay the paste in it, making it neat and even round the broad edge of the plate. With a sharp knife, trim off the superfluous dough, and notch the edges. Put in the mixture with a spoon, and bake the pudding about half an hour, in a moderate oven. It should be baked of a very light brown. If the oven is too hot, the paste will not have time to rise well. If too cold, it will be clammy. When the pudding is cool, grate loaf-sugar over it. Before using lemons for any purpose, always roll them awhile with your hand on a table. This will cause them to yield a larger quantity of juice.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s0","text":"Thoroughly rinse the lentils and drain the water.","groupId":null},{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s1","text":"Put the lentils in the pot, and add 1 L (0.26 gal) of water.","groupId":null},{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s2","text":"Bring to a boil, and gently boil for about 15-20 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s3","text":"Drain the water.","groupId":null},{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s4","text":"Add the other ingredients to the pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s5","text":"Add 10.5-2 tsp of salt and a little bit of ground black pepper.","groupId":null},{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s6","text":"Add 0.5 L (0.13 gal) of boiling water.","groupId":null},{"id":"lenten-lentil-curry-s7","text":"Simmer for about 10 minutes. Have a blessed Lent.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Limoncello
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"limoncello-s0","text":"Pour the alcohol into a 1 liter mason jar","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncello-s1","text":"Peel the lemons avoiding the white pith (it will make your limoncello bitter) and submerse them in the alcohol","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncello-s2","text":"Cover the jar and let the lemons infuse the alcohol for 20 days","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncello-s3","text":"After the infusion is completed, create a simple syrup by boiling the water and dissolving the sugar in the water","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncello-s4","text":"Allow the water to cool completely, then strain the alcohol into the sugar water and stir","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncello-s5","text":"Bottle or put it back into the mason jar","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncello-s6","text":"Feel free to scale the recipe up or down, and adjust the sugar to the sweetness you like, but the ABV should remain somewhere around 28-30%","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Limoncini
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"limoncini-s0","text":"Cut the butter and let it soften.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s1","text":"Dissolve the yeast in warm milk and softened butter.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s2","text":"Add sugar and stir.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s3","text":"Add the other dough ingredients and knead for a few minutes until you have a soft dough.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s4","text":"Cover the dough and let it rise for about an hour.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s5","text":"Meanwhile, grate the skin of the lemons.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s6","text":"Add sugar and mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s7","text":"Store the stuffing in a dry place.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s8","text":"Roll out the dough to 1 or 2 a rectangles about 3 mm thick.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s9","text":"Spread the stuffing on all the surface of the dough.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s10","text":"Roll up the rectangle(s) tightly.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s11","text":"Cut the rolls in slices about 1 cm thick.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s12","text":"Lay them on baking paper in an oven tray.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s13","text":"Let them rise again for another hour.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s14","text":"Preheat the oven to 180 °C.","groupId":null},{"id":"limoncini-s15","text":"Cook for about 20 minutes. Pay attention not to overcook: check after about 10 minutes.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: lemon untreated. Make sure the skin is edible!

recipes.name: Lithuanian Cold Borscht
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"lithuanian-cold-borscht-s0","text":"Wash 2-3 beets and cook in 2-3 litres of water (do not drain), peel. Grate on a medium or coarse grater. Squeeze a little lemon juice into the liquid in which the beets have been cooked, mix, then add salt, sugar and pepper to taste. Cool in the fridge. Instead of boiled beets, you can grate pickled beets.","groupId":null},{"id":"lithuanian-cold-borscht-s1","text":"Thinly slice the fresh cucumber and mix with chopped dill and parsley. You can also add chopped radishes if you like.","groupId":null},{"id":"lithuanian-cold-borscht-s2","text":"Bake or boil the potatoes without peeling.","groupId":null},{"id":"lithuanian-cold-borscht-s3","text":"Boil an egg for each portion of soup.","groupId":null},{"id":"lithuanian-cold-borscht-s4","text":"Place a few large spoonfuls of cooled grated beetroot and vegetable mixture in a bowl. Pour in the cold kefir. Add the cooled beetroot decoction (50-150 ml). If the kefir is too thick, add a little more liquid (the ratio of kefir to beetroot liquid varies from region to region and is adjusted to taste).","groupId":null},{"id":"lithuanian-cold-borscht-s5","text":"Serve with potatoes and with a halved egg and spoonful of thick sour cream on top; sprinkle with chives. If you like, you can make it without the egg (as in the photo).","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: Kefir about 150-300 ml per serving

recipes.name: Liver Pate
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"liverpate-s0","text":"Cut liver into cubes.","groupId":null},{"id":"liverpate-s1","text":"Put into a pot and cover with cold water, add 1tsp salt. Bring to a boil and boil for 10-15 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"liverpate-s2","text":"Grate carrots and dice onions. Stew in a frying pan with a little bit of water until soft.","groupId":null},{"id":"liverpate-s3","text":"In a food processor blend all ingredients together.","groupId":null},{"id":"liverpate-s4","text":"With beef liver, remove its membrane, that is on top, with your fingers. Cut it in small pieces even cubes or slices and remove the vessels that are inside it. They are not very tasty and are impossible to chew.","groupId":"liverpate-dg0"}],"groups":[{"id":"liverpate-dg0","title":"Notes"}]}

recipes.name: Loaded Mexican Rice
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"loaded-mexican-rice-s0","text":"Cook rice per manufactures instructions.","groupId":null},{"id":"loaded-mexican-rice-s1","text":"Pore enough neutral oil in a large pan to cover the bottom entirely, and turn on to medium heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"loaded-mexican-rice-s2","text":"Once pan is hot add rice, brake up the rice to ensue there are no clumps.","groupId":null},{"id":"loaded-mexican-rice-s3","text":"Add tomato paste and chilies to the pan, mix until rice is coated add water if needed.","groupId":null},{"id":"loaded-mexican-rice-s4","text":"Strain and add the beans, corn, and peas; if you are adding meat and or onion do so now.","groupId":null},{"id":"loaded-mexican-rice-s5","text":"Mix well, ensue peas and corn thaw.","groupId":null},{"id":"loaded-mexican-rice-s6","text":"Serve hot as either a burrito or bowl with your choice of fillings/toppings.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Long-cooked Chuck Steak With Vegetables
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"long-cooked-chuck-steak-s0","text":"Add a little of the olive oil to the long cooker, put in the meat, and set it to high.","groupId":null},{"id":"long-cooked-chuck-steak-s1","text":"Chop the onion and add it.","groupId":null},{"id":"long-cooked-chuck-steak-s2","text":"Cut the cauliflower to sizes you prefer and add.","groupId":null},{"id":"long-cooked-chuck-steak-s3","text":"Chop or slice 0.333 of the fennel and add.","groupId":null},{"id":"long-cooked-chuck-steak-s4","text":"Crush the tomatoes and add (or add the canned chopped tomatoes).","groupId":null},{"id":"long-cooked-chuck-steak-s5","text":"Add the rest of the olive oil and let it be for at least 6 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"long-cooked-chuck-steak-s6","text":"Serve with the rest of the fennel (chop or sliced).","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu (麻婆豆腐)
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"mapo-tofu-s0","text":"Marinade the pork in shaoxing cooking wine, a splash of cooking oil, the soy sauce,","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s1","text":"Add cooking oil to a wok and sear the ground pork until browned, chopping it up as it cooks","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s2","text":"Add the doubanjiang and let it simmer for about a minute","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s3","text":"Add the minced aromatics (ginger, garlic) scallion whites, and dou-chi and cook until fragrant","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s4","text":"Add the stock and a splash of soy sauce, turn up the gas and bring to a boil","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s5","text":"Add the tofu, lower the gas, and braise for around 15 mins","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s6","text":"You'll know it's done when the tofu shows their trademark \"pockmarks\" and the seasoning sticks to them","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s7","text":"Mix in the crushed Sichuan peppercorns and green parts of the scallions right before serving","groupId":null},{"id":"mapo-tofu-s8","text":"Serve over steamed rice","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Maque Choux
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"maque-choux-s0","text":"Clean the corn and cut lengthwise about a thumbnail (0.25 in) from the top and scrape down using the soft end of a knife (to keep the juices).","groupId":null},{"id":"maque-choux-s1","text":"Mix all ingredients in a bowl excluding the grease. Salt & pepper to taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"maque-choux-s2","text":"Pour mixture into a pot with hot grease in it at low heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"maque-choux-s3","text":"Cover pot and cook for 45 minutes, and stir as you get up for more beers.","groupId":null},{"id":"maque-choux-s4","text":"Serve. (Serves 4-6)","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Marinated pork steaks
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"marinated-pork-steaks-s0","text":"Mix olive oil, soy sauce, honey and lime juice until you have an even marinade. Add pepper and crushed garlic.","groupId":null},{"id":"marinated-pork-steaks-s1","text":"Add the pork steaks to the marinade and leave in room temperature for 30 minutes or a bit longer.","groupId":null},{"id":"marinated-pork-steaks-s2","text":"Preheat your grill/frying pan. Add marinated steaks, grill for 2 minutes, flip, repeat until you've grilled them for 10 minutes total. Towards the last minutes pour the remaining marinade over the steaks.","groupId":null},{"id":"marinated-pork-steaks-s3","text":"Let the steaks rest for 10 minutes before serving. And just like that you got yourself some tasty pork steaks.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: inch thick boneless pork shoulder steaks

recipes.name: Matcha Cookies
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"matcha-cookies-s0","text":"Melt butter in a bath or microwave.","groupId":null},{"id":"matcha-cookies-s1","text":"Add white sugar, brown sugar and salt and mix with a whisk","groupId":null},{"id":"matcha-cookies-s2","text":"Add egg and vanilla extract and mix with a whisk until well mixed.","groupId":null},{"id":"matcha-cookies-s3","text":"Add flour, matcha powder and baking soda and mix with a whisk until you can hardly see the powder.","groupId":null},{"id":"matcha-cookies-s4","text":"Add white coverture chocolate  and macadamia and mix evenly with spatula.","groupId":null},{"id":"matcha-cookies-s5","text":"Allow 30 minutes to 1 hour in the refrigerator until the dough hardens.","groupId":null},{"id":"matcha-cookies-s6","text":"Pan with a 5cm diameter cookie and bake at 170°C (338°F) for 9 minutes. (Unox convection oven)  Preheat the oven beforehand. My oven is very hot, so raise the oven temperature a little bit higher if you have common oven.  If you bake too little, it will not be cooked. If you bake too long, it will become hard. * The white coverture chocolate melts smoothly in your mouth, and the white chocolate chip has a more chewy texture. So you can choose anything to your taste.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Orange jam
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"orange-jam-s0","text":"Zest all fruit.","groupId":null},{"id":"orange-jam-s1","text":"Peel off the albedo (the white part under the skin).","groupId":null},{"id":"orange-jam-s2","text":"Blend the fruit (not too much, it doesn't need to become an even mush, just cut up into small pieces).","groupId":null},{"id":"orange-jam-s3","text":"Combine the blended fruit, zest, and sugar in a pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"orange-jam-s4","text":"Bring to boil and boil for 30-40 minutes on low heat. The mixture will thicken as water evaporates. Note that it will thicken even further once it cools, so don't boil for too long - it is expected to be still a little runny at the end of boiling.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Mazurek
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"mazurek-s0","text":"Put flour and butter in a bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s1","text":"Cut the butter with a sharp knife into tiny pieces, mixing with the flour.","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s2","text":"Add egg yolks, sugar, sour cream, and a pinch of salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s3","text":"Knead well and form into a ball. Wrap in plastic wrap and let chill in fridge for about an hour.","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s4","text":"Roll out flat and place in large baking sheet (this should be enough for a 25x35cm/10x14in sheet) on top of parchment paper.","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s5","text":"Make little holes with fork in the dough.","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s6","text":"Bake for 15-20 minutes in 200°C (395°F).","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s7","text":"Let cool before spreading topping.","groupId":null},{"id":"mazurek-s8","text":"Decorate with nuts or other toppings.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Meatloaf
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"meatloaf-s0","text":"Once thawed, put all of your beef into a bowl. The next 4 steps will all go into this same bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s1","text":"Dice the onion and bread slices into small pieces. Add them.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s2","text":"Crack and put in all of your eggs.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s3","text":"Pour in your milk, and a moderate amount of mustard and ketchup.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s4","text":"Add garlic salt and onion powder.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s5","text":"Now you must use your (sanitized) hands and mix everything in the big bowl well. Make sure you get the bottom.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s6","text":"Evenly distribute your mixed meat into 2 or 3 oven safe greased up dishes. Try to flatten the surface as much as you can.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s7","text":"In each dish, create a small channel in the middle of each meatloaf. This is to maintain the shape as it's cooking.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s8","text":"Put all of your meatloaf filled dishes into the oven on 180 Celsius for 1 hour.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s9","text":"Once you have about 15 minutes left on your timer, get started on your sauce.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s10","text":"Toss your 3 sugar cubes into a bowl with a little bit of hot water to melt them.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s11","text":"Add your tomato soup, 0.25 Cup of ketchup and mustard (each).","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s12","text":"Stir sauce until it's a thick, light red color.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s13","text":"Once 1 hour is up, take out all of your meatloaf. Make sure to cut open the thickest meatloaf and confirm the beef is cooked.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s14","text":"Coat the top of each of your meatloaves with the sauce, evenly.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s15","text":"Once coated, put back into the oven for 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"meatloaf-s16","text":"Take out all of your meatloaf. Once cool, slice it up and serve!","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Medieval Beef Soup
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s0","text":"Cube the roast into bite sized pieces and place them in a large skillet with the butter.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s1","text":"Heat the pan on medium-high heat and brown the meat with the melted butter until the outside is evenly cooked, sprinkle with pepper as it browns.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s2","text":"While the meat is browning, cut the greens off the turnips and set them aside. Cut the turnips into bite sized pieces making sure to cut the top and bottom ends off first. If you can not find turnips with their greens still attached Mustard greens can be substituted.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s3","text":"Put the cut up turnips in the slow cooker and pour in the chicken stock.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s4","text":"Take the meat and dump it into the slow cooker drippings and all. If the amount of liquid looks a bit low to you, you can pour in another cup or so of water at your discretion.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s5","text":"Sprinkle more pepper over the soup and put the saffron in the bowl of warm water and let it seep for five minutes. Then dump it and the warm water into the soup.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s6","text":"Cut the stems off of the greens and then chop the greens vertically.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s7","text":"Cook the soup on high for 2 to 2 0.5 hours or until the turnip and meat are soft and tender. About 20 minutes before it is to be done take the chopped greens and put them in the soup. Don't worry if it overfills the slow cooker, the greens will shrink a ton. Cook for about 20 minutes until done.","groupId":null},{"id":"medieval-beef-soup-s8","text":"Taste the soup, if it's still too bland you can add spices of your choice and season to your taste.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: Around three to four large turnips with their greens attached

recipes.name: Merchant's Buckwheat
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s0","text":"Chop the onion and cut the pork into small pieces.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s1","text":"Dust the pork with some flour. I sometimes like to do this once I've added the pork to the pan, just because I am lazy and I haven't noticed much difference between either approach.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s2","text":"Heat the frying pan add a bit of oil, add the pork and onion, and fry for about 10-15 minutes over medium-high heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s3","text":"While the pork and onion are being fried, cut the carrot into small pieces and chop the parsley.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s4","text":"Once the pork and onion are fried, add the water, tomato paste, buckwheat and carrots.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s5","text":"Add curcuma, chili powder, salt and black pepper to taste; mix thoroughly.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s6","text":"Add in the garlic cloves, bay leaves and chopped parsley.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s7","text":"Once the water is boiling, close the pan with a lid and stew for about 25 minutes over low heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"merchants-buckwheat-s8","text":"Serve hot and enjoy!","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Mexican Meat Loaf
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"mexican-meat-loaf-s0","text":"In bowl, place all ingredients except spray and using 0.75 cup of the salsa - mix well.","groupId":null},{"id":"mexican-meat-loaf-s1","text":"Spray a loaf pan (approx. 5\"x9\"), and add above mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"mexican-meat-loaf-s2","text":"Bake for 50 to 60 minutes - sit 15 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"mexican-meat-loaf-s3","text":"Top with last 0.25 cup of salsa.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Modern Borscht
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"modern-borscht-s0","text":"Finely dice onion and garlic cloves. Set aside in large bowl 1.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s1","text":"Cut off beet greens. Skin carrots and beets.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s2","text":"Finely slice carrots and celery (2-3 mm maximum, 0.063-0.125\" maximum). Add to large bowl 1.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s3","text":"Shred beets using cheese grater. Or, if preferred, cut into small cubes no greater than 1x1 inch in size. Shredded beets break down better when cooked and release more flavor into the broth. Set aside in large bowl 2.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s4","text":"Cut beef into 1x1 inch cubes, or \"Spoon size\" cubes","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s5","text":"15 minutes before the end of the first simmer - Cut potatoes into 1x1 cubes. Do not cut them too soon or the flesh will turn brown.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s6","text":"After adding potatoes into the simmering mixture - Remove outer leaf and cut head of cabbage into quarters. Then dice the quarters.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s7","text":"Use high heat and get the 5qt pot hot. Flick a few drops of water onto the pot and when they start \"dancing\" it is hot enough.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s8","text":"Coat the bottom of the pot with a thin layer of olive oil and let it heat up for about 30 seconds to 1 minute.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s9","text":"Sear the beef on all sides until all cubes are browned. Salt and pepper the beef to taste. It is OK if the meat sticks to the bottom of the pot. Place a strainer in large bowl 3.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s10","text":"Once browned, remove the beef from the pot. Place into strainer and let the juices drain.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s11","text":"Add the carrot/onion/celery/garlic mixture from large bowl 1 to the hot pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s12","text":"Add 0.25 to 0.333 stick of butter to this veggie mixture. Stir and agitate constantly until onions and celery are translucent and carrots begin to soften.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s13","text":"Add the strained meat, the beets from large bowl 2, the canned tomatoes, the beef stock, the cumin, the bay leaves, and the coriander to the pot. Stir until well blended.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s14","text":"Bring mixture to a boil on high heat. When a boil is achieved, reduce heat to a simmer and simmer for 60 minutes with the lid on. REMINDER - after 45 minutes, cube the potatoes.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s15","text":"After 60 minutes of simmering, add the cubed potatoes and the dill (to taste) to the mixture. Stir until well blended. Cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. REMINDER - during this 15 minute simmer, dice the 0.5 head of cabbage.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s16","text":"After 15 minutes, or until potatoes are soft, add the cabbage to the pot. Simmer for 2 minutes uncovered to heat the cabbage.","groupId":null},{"id":"modern-borscht-s17","text":"Serve. The cabbage should be hot, yet still crunchy. It will retain this crunchiness through refrigeration and re-heating due to the short heat cycle. 1-2 spoonfulls of sour cream is recommended per bowl for additional flavor.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: beef tenderloin, or stew meat if you are frugal
large potatoes
ingredients.description: (Yukon Gold preferred, but any quality potatoes work)

ingredients.name: beef stock
ingredients.description: (or quality beef bullion such as "Better than Bullion" or equivalent and 4 cups water)

recipes.name: Mushroom Stroganov
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s0","text":"Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta al dente","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s1","text":"In a cup, combine flour, mustard, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Add broth and whisk until no lumps remain.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s2","text":"While pasta is cooking, melt butter in a medium skillet and over medium heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s3","text":"When the butter is melted, add onions and cook until softened.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s4","text":"Add mushrooms and cook until all water evaporates and mushrooms are slightly browned, about 7 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s5","text":"Add garlic and cook for another 30 seconds.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s6","text":"Pour the flour and broth mixture into the mushrooms and cook until thickens, about 2 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s7","text":"Stir in Creme Fraiche.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s8","text":"Add the strained pasta to the mushroom sauce and stir to coat the pasta completely.","groupId":null},{"id":"mushroom-stragonov-s9","text":"Serve immediately.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: uncooked pasta
ingredients.description: (spaghetti or any other long noodle will work. Stroganov can also be served over rice.)

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.description: (I reccommend shitake, but white, portabello, or maitake will also work.)

ingredients.name: creme fraiche
ingredients.description: (can be made by mixing equal parts heavy and sour cream)

recipes.name: Naan Bread
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"naan-bread-s0","text":"Put the yeast and sugar to warm milk in a large mixing bowl and stir well. Leave it for 3-5 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"naan-bread-s1","text":"Put the flour and salt into a large mixing bowl and whisk to combine.  Sprinkle additional flour as needed to keep the dough from sticking to the sides.","groupId":null},{"id":"naan-bread-s2","text":"Once the dough is soft and ready, apply oil on it and cover it with a soft cloth. Rest it for 2–3 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"naan-bread-s3","text":"Knead the dough again, sprinkle all-purpose flour, and knead until smooth.","groupId":null},{"id":"naan-bread-s4","text":"Divide dough into 4 equal pieces. Form pieces into balls. Roll out dough balls to desired thickness (about the size of a small tortilla).","groupId":null},{"id":"naan-bread-s5","text":"Now transfer the naan to the foiled baking tray and bake in preheated at 180 C for 30-35 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"naan-bread-s6","text":"After baking, brush the top with butter and cut it into four pieces and serve. Enjoy!","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Nashville Chicken Sandwich
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"nashville-chicken-s0","text":"Prep your chicken by trimming it into less than a 0.5\" patties for frying.","groupId":null},{"id":"nashville-chicken-s1","text":"Prepare your batter and flour in two separate bowls.","groupId":null},{"id":"nashville-chicken-s2","text":"Dunk your chicken into the flour, then batter and then flour again. While your chicken is sitting with the battered flour pour 2 0.5 cups of cooking oil into your pan over medium heat or 350 degrees. Let it come to temp, about 20 mins.","groupId":null},{"id":"nashville-chicken-s3","text":"Once your oil has reached the temp of 350, go ahead and fry 3-4 pieces of chicken at one time. You are going to fry for 7 mins (flipping at the midway point) and then pull the chicken and let sit for 5 mins then refry for the second time 3 mins, this depends on the thickness of the chicken.","groupId":null},{"id":"nashville-chicken-s4","text":"Now that your chicken is fried make sure you have a wire rack with a sheet pan under it so the crispy chicken can sit and rest on. recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"pilaf-s0","text":"Put the cooking oil in a cauldron and heat it until the oil is boiling, add a head of onion until it is black, then throw it out.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s1","text":"Throw coarsely chopped meat into the cauldron and let it boil until it's golden brown, then add a pinch of salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s2","text":"Add the chopped onions, then wait 2 minutes and add the sliced carrots, boil for another 2 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s3","text":"Add 500 ml of water diluted with tomato paste, boil for 5 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s4","text":"Rinse the rice and put it into the cauldron but do not mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s5","text":"Add another 500 ml of water diluted with tomato paste and wait until it is boiling.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s6","text":"Reduce the heat to minimum, then add two table spoons of salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s7","text":"Close the cauldron and leave it on low heat for 1.5-2 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s8","text":"1 hour before it is ready(or when you can't see water above the rice), add the garlic.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s9","text":"You can now turn over the rice if it is undercooked and add some raisins.","groupId":null},{"id":"pilaf-s10","text":"Keep boiling until all water is evaporated.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Plum Pudding
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"plum-pudding-s0","text":"You must prepare all your ingredients the day before (except beating the eggs) that in the morning you may have nothing to do but to mix them, as the pudding will require six hours to boil.","groupId":null},{"id":"plum-pudding-s1","text":"Beat the eggs very light, then put to them half the milk and beat both together. Stir in gradually the flour and grated bread. Next add the sugar by degrees. Then the suet and fruit alternately. The fruit must be well sprinkled with flour, lest it sink to the bottom. Stir very hard. Then add the spice and liquor, and lastly the remainder of the milk. Stir the whole mixture very well together. If it is not thick enough, add a little more grated bread or flour. If there is too much bread or flour, the pudding will be hard and heavy.","groupId":null},{"id":"plum-pudding-s2","text":"Dip your pudding-cloth, in boiling water, shake it out and sprinkle it slightly with flour. Lay it in a pan and pour the mixture into the cloth. Tie it up carefully, allowing room for the pudding to swell.","groupId":null},{"id":"plum-pudding-s3","text":"Boil it six hours, and turn it carefully out of the cloth.","groupId":null},{"id":"plum-pudding-s4","text":"Before you send it to table, have ready some blanched sweet almonds cut in slips, or some slips of citron, or both. Stick them all over the outside of the pudding. Eat it with wine, or with a sauce made of drawn butter, wine and nutmeg. The pudding will be improved if you add to the other ingredients, the grated rind of a large lemon or orange.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Slow-cooked Pork Carnitas
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"pork-carnitas-s0","text":"Season pork with kosher salt and pepper.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s1","text":"In a medium sauté pan on medium-high heat, brown pork on all sides.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s2","text":"Remove from heat and allow to cool, about 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s3","text":"Using a sharp knife, insert blade into pork, cutting small holes and insert garlic slivers as far in as you can.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s4","text":"Pour chicken broth in slow cooker.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s5","text":"Add pork and season with cumin, adobo, sazon, and oregano.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s6","text":"Add bay leaves and chipotle peppers.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s7","text":"Cover and cook low for 8 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s8","text":"After 8 hours, shred pork using 2 forks and combine with juices.","groupId":null},{"id":"pork-carnitas-s9","text":"Let cook for another 15-30 mins.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Potato Leek Soup
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"potato-leek-soup-s0","text":"Chop the white to light-green part of the leek into moderately sized pieces and discard the dark-green ends.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-leek-soup-s1","text":"Melt the butter in a pot on medium-low heat, add chopped leeks and potatoes. Stir until leeks are sweat.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-leek-soup-s2","text":"Add stock, bay leaf, pepper and optional ingredients now. Raise heat to medium-high, simmer until potatoes are tender.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-leek-soup-s3","text":"After removing the pot from the heat, remove the bay leaf and immersion blend pot until you reach a desired consistency.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-leek-soup-s4","text":"Stir in heavy cream and salt to taste.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Potato purée
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"potato-pure-s0","text":"Peel the potatoes and cut them to small pieces. The smaller, the faster to cook.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-pure-s1","text":"Put them in a pot and cover with water.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-pure-s2","text":"Bring to boil and cook until potatoes are soft.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-pure-s3","text":"Drain and mash with a fork.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-pure-s4","text":"Warm up milk, but don't let it boil.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-pure-s5","text":"Still on the fire, add butter and mashed potatoes, and optionally grated cheese, and stir until uniform.","groupId":null},{"id":"potato-pure-s6","text":"Keep stirring on the fire to thicken as you like.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Pretzels
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"pretzels-s0","text":"Make the dough by mixing the water, yeast, sugar, and salt with as much flour as you can stir in, then let the dough sit for 15 minutes to autolyse.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s1","text":"Knead in the remaining flour, which should be enough to give you a dough that is just barely sticky.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s2","text":"Cover the dough and let it rise overnight in the refrigerator for best flavor, or for about 2 hours on the counter.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s3","text":"Pull the risen dough out onto a cutting board and cut it into quarters, for the four pretzels we are making. Smash each quarter piece down flat and roll it into a log.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s4","text":"Cover the dough logs and let them rest for about 15 minutes to let the gluten relax for easier shaping. Start preheating the oven to 450℉ (230℃) while these rest.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s5","text":"Roll each log out into a long thin snake, leaving the center \"belly\" thicker, also don't do this with the counter covered in flour. Pull the ends of a \"snake\" towards you to make an upside-down 'U' shape, fold the \"arms\" over each other twice, then back towards the \"belly\". Seal the tips on the belly by pressing them down firmly onto it. Don't do the next steps too slowly to prevent the pretzels from puffing up much after being shaped.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s6","text":"Using a heat-safe and chemically non-reactive vessel (such as a pyrex baking dish) create the lye bath by putting in the 5 cups of water and slowly sprinkle in the sodium hydroxide while gently mixing.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s7","text":"Glove your hands with latex gloves or some other kind of chemical-resistant ones and fully submerge each of the four pretzels one at a time into the lye bath for 10 seconds each. Drain each pretzel thouroughly before transfering them to baking sheets","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s8","text":"Sprinkle the crunchy finishing salt over the the pretzels and score each pretzel's belly with a knife for aesthetics and to allow it to expand more in the oven.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s9","text":"Bake pretzels until they are deep mahogany all over. This should take around 15 minutes. The sodium hydroxide should react with the dough and harmlessly evaporate in the oven.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s10","text":"Store or dispose the lye bath. To easily dispose of the lye bath, slowly drizzle the lye down the drain with the faucet running, to dilute it.","groupId":null},{"id":"pretzels-s11","text":"If at any point you get lye on your skin, wash it off in the sink promptly. It may cause minor skin irritation.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: sugar, honey, barley syrup, or molasses, etc.

recipes.name: Puff Pastry
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"puff-pastry-s0","text":"Before starting on the dough, place the butter between two pieces of plastic wrap. Pound into a flat disc using a rolling pin or other heavy object. Refrigerate until firm, roughly 20 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"puff-pastry-s1","text":"Mix the flour and salt in a large bowl or in the bowl of a stand mixer with a dough hook. Gradually stir in water until the dough holds together enough to clean the sides of the bowl. The dough should not be sticky, but it should not be dry. Do not put all the water in as you may not need all of it. Let the dough sit for at least 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"puff-pastry-s2","text":"On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough into a large rectangle about 0.5 inch thick. Place the butter in the center and fold the two ends over it so that it is fully encased in dough. Roll out the dough again, taking care to not let the butter break through the surface. Once the dough is about 0.5 inch thick again fold into thirds. The butter should be warm now, place into fridge for 30 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"puff-pastry-s3","text":"Repeat rolling and folding two more times, then refrigerate again until firm.","groupId":null},{"id":"puff-pastry-s4","text":"Repeat two or more times until the dough was rolled roughly 6 times, then wrap and refrigerate. The dough can now be used in recipes calling for puff pastry. Roll out thin, about 0.25 inch, and bake at 400 degrees F for best results.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Quarkbällchen – Fried curd balls
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"quarkbaellchen-s0","text":"Mix ingredients (quark, eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder) in one bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"quarkbaellchen-s1","text":"Pour the sunflower oil into a cooking pot and heat up the hotplate","groupId":null},{"id":"quarkbaellchen-s2","text":"Form balls from the dough and put them into the cooking pot","groupId":null},{"id":"quarkbaellchen-s3","text":"Once they are brown-ish, put them onto a plate","groupId":null},{"id":"quarkbaellchen-s4","text":"(Optional) add icing sugar","groupId":null},{"id":"quarkbaellchen-s5","text":"Enjoy!","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Quesadilla
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"quesadilla-s0","text":"Heat a pan to medium with an (optional) thin coating of oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"quesadilla-s1","text":"Lay a single tortilla down on the pan and arrange cheese on the edges. Arrange on 1 edge if you are making a folded quesadilla. Do both edges if using 2 tortillas. The cheese will help make sure the ingredients don't fall out when flipping.","groupId":null},{"id":"quesadilla-s2","text":"Add the ingredients onto one half of the tortilla if using 1, or the entire surface if using 2.","groupId":null},{"id":"quesadilla-s3","text":"Fold empty half of the tortilla in the pan onto itself if you are only using one tortilla. If you are using 2 simply place the second on top of the first.","groupId":null},{"id":"quesadilla-s4","text":"Periodically flip the tortilla until both sides are golden brown. This may be hard if using 2 tortillas, so try your best or transfer it to a plate, flip it with your hands, and transfer it back to the pan.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

If you don't have pre-grated cheese, you can cut thin slices off of the block of cheese.
A thin coating of oil on the pan. It will be more traditional, but also more unhealthy.
Any ingredients you want. ie, veggies, chicken, mushrooms , or beans

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine - Lothringer Käsetorte
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"quiche-s0","text":"Spread some butter on a 26cm Ø or two smaller baking tins and cover it with flour","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s1","text":"Sieve the flour, mingle the butter/margarine in small flakes.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s2","text":"Form a depression in the middle of the flour and add spoons of water.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s3","text":"Mix all ingredients by hand until the dough becomes a homogenious mass.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s4","text":"Wrap the dough in aluminium foil and let it rest in the fridge for two hours (around -4 °C).","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s5","text":"Preheat the oven at 200°C.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s6","text":"Spread the dough on a flour-covered surface. Roll it until it has a thickness of around 4mm. Form a crust on the sides.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s7","text":"Use a fork to prick the dough for a more thorough heat penetration.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s8","text":"Cut the ham in slices and distribute them evenly on the dough.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s9","text":"Divide the yolk from the egg white.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s10","text":"Whisk the yolk with cream.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s11","text":"Add the grinded cheese.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s12","text":"Whisk the egg white until it becomes foamy. Add it to the yolk-pepper-salt-cheese mixture.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s13","text":"Cover the ham in the baking tin with the mixture. Equalize the surface.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s14","text":"Bake the Quiche in the oven on the middle rail for 30 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"quiche-s15","text":"After baking leave it to rest for a few minutes, then serve while it's still warm. I recommend serving it with a glass of white wine.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Rabbits with Onions
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"rabbit-onions-s0","text":"Peel, boil, and slice six (or more) large onions, and season them with nutmeg, and a very little cayenne. Cover them, and set them aside till wanted.","groupId":null},{"id":"rabbit-onions-s1","text":"Cut the meat from two rabbits into pieces, and fry them in fresh butter or lard. When browned, and nearly done, cover them with the sliced onions, and brown them, having laid among them some bits of fresh butter rolled in flour.","groupId":null},{"id":"rabbit-onions-s2","text":"Dish the rabbits, with the pieces entirely hidden under the onions.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Ragu Napoletano
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s0","text":"If you already have tomato sauce skip to step 5","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s1","text":"For fresh tomatoes, wash and cut out off the green stems of the tomatoes and cut them into a few chunks and lightly salt them over a collander or strainer so they release water and break down quicker.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s2","text":"For canned tomatoes, use your hands to crush the peeled tomatoes (don't use a food processor).","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s3","text":"In a large stock pot cook down the tomatoes for approximately 30 mins then use a food mill or strainer to remove the skins and seeds to yield tomato sauce (this can be done beforehand and frozen / canned for months).","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s4","text":"Mix all the ingredients in the Meatballs section by hand and form equal sized meatballs.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s5","text":"Either bake the meatballs at 400°F until brown or fry them with the the other meats in step 7.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s6","text":"Coat the bottom of a dutch oven or large stock pot with olive oil and  sear each meat one by one, removing from the pot once browned on the outside (do not cook the meat all the way through).","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s7","text":"Sweat the onion and garlic, then deglaze the pan with the red wine.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s8","text":"Fill the pot with the seared meat, tomato sauce, add the fresh basil, then season with dried oregano, red pepper, salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar to taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s9","text":"Cook on very low flame uncovered for 4-5 hours stirring making sure it doesn't burn.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-napoletano-s10","text":"Serve over cooked dry pasta such as ziti, penne, rigatoni. Alternatively, freeze the sauce and meats in containers for up to 4-6 months.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Ragù
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"ragu-s0","text":"Sauté sausage crumbles in a large pan or dutch oven over medium-low heat. Add enough olive oil to gently fry the crumbles. Cook about five minutes until opaque, not browned.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s1","text":"Add minced onion, carrot, and celery, and parsley to the pan. Stir often and add more olive oil if pan is dry. Cook 30 minutes on very low heat until vegetables are caramelized and sausage is browned.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s2","text":"Add canned tomatoes and their juice. Break up tomatoes in the pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s3","text":"Bring to a simmer then add thyme and rosemary","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s4","text":"Continue simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, until thickened.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s5","text":"Mix tomato paste with 1 cup of hot water. Reduce heat to very low and add mix to the pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s6","text":"Cook about 10 minutes until the sauce is dark red and glistens with oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s7","text":"Remove herb sprigs and add pepper to taste.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s8","text":"Meanwhile, boil large pot of salted water then cook and drain the pasta.","groupId":null},{"id":"ragu-s9","text":"Serve ragù over plate of pasta and top with grated parmesan cheese;","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Ravioli
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"ravioli-s0","text":"The basic rule of thumb I use for pasta is 100g, 1 egg per person","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s1","text":"For this recipe you can go two ways, the old school \"well\" method or a kitchen aid mixer (skip to step 7)","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s2","text":"For the well method, pile the flour onto the counter and with your hand carve a hole or a well in the center","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s3","text":"Crack the eggs into the center of the well, and drizzle a bit of olive oil into the center","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s4","text":"With a fork, begin slowly breaking up, mixing, and incorporating the egg into the flour until there is no longer any loose egg that can escape the outer well border","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s5","text":"At this point use your hands to bring the sandy mixture together and knead the dough for about 5-10 minutes or until the dough is smooth","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s6","text":"For the stand mixer method just throw all the ingredients into the mixer with a dough hook and set it to level 4 for about 3-5 minutes and it will be done","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s7","text":"You might need to scrape the sides down and maybe hand knead the dough a bit longer after it's done to make it into a nice smooth ball","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s8","text":"Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest in the fridge a bit so it's easier to roll out (15-30 mins)","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s9","text":"While the dough is resting, make the filling by first mixing the  ricotta and egg into a bowl","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s10","text":"Zest and juice a lemon peel into the bowl","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s11","text":"Optionally add seafood ingredients at this point","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s12","text":"Grate the Pecorino into the bowl, add salt and pepper to taste, and mix to distribute the ingredients evenly","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s13","text":"Take out the dough and cut it into 4 pieces, keeping the ones not currently being worked on covered so they don't dry out","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s14","text":"Roll the dough out with a pasta machine down to the point where you can just barely see your hand through it (setting 2-3 out of 7) or roll it out with a rolling pin into a long sheet, maybe like 16 x 8 inches or so","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s15","text":"At this point you can either cut the sheet in half and make two sheets, a top and bottom, or one sheet, where you will fold the dough over and use the folded seam as one side of the ravioli","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s16","text":"Using a teaspoon, evenly space out the ricotta filling onto the sheets, leaving a few inches on each side for the seams","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s17","text":"As stated in step 16, either take the 2nd sheet and place it over top or fold over the dough and press down firmly, forcing out any air and making sure the two pieces of dough stick","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s18","text":"You may need to brush some water onto the dough if it is too heavily floured and not sticking","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s19","text":"Using a fancy pasta cutter, a knife, or even a pizza cutter, cut evenly between the seams of the raviolis to separate them","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s20","text":"If you used a pasta cutter, you are now done, store the raviolis on a floured wax paper sheet or freeze them for later","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s21","text":"If you don't have a pasta cutter, use a fork to press down the dough around the edges of the cut raviolis to ensure they are firmly closed and no leaks or air bubbles are visible, or else they will explode when cooked","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s22","text":"To cook, throw them in salted boiling water and they will let you know when they're done when they float to the top (1-2 minutes)","groupId":null},{"id":"ravioli-s23","text":"Serve the seafood version with a simple fresh red sauce and basil, or spice it up a bit and go with a base of red sauce with some added heavy cream, and a pinch of red pepper flakes to make a pink sauce for the seafood version","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dahl

Add tomatoes and lentils. Bring to a boil and then lower the heat a bit and simmer for 20 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"red-lentil-dahl-s4","text":"Add the lemon juice and cilantro and more water if it's too thick.  Simmer 10 more minutes, or until lentils are completely tender. This may take a while.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Refried Beans
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"refried-beans-s0","text":"Add the oil and the butter to the frying pan and heat to medium heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"refried-beans-s1","text":"Chop the onion and mince the garlic.","groupId":null},{"id":"refried-beans-s2","text":"Once the frying pan is heated, add the onion and garlic to the pan, and fry them for about 3 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"refried-beans-s3","text":"Add salt, cumin, and paprika to taste. Usually I add paprika until the mix is a brownish red. Mix with your spatula, and let fry for about 5 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"refried-beans-s4","text":"Open the can of beans and pour the beans into the pan. Depending on how liquid you want the refried beans to be, you can use all or just some part of the liquid inside the can. I usually get rid of some of the liquid from the can before pouring the beans.","groupId":null},{"id":"refried-beans-s5","text":"Mash the beans and mix. Let them fry at medium-low to medium heat for about 5 to 10 minutes, mixing from time to time.","groupId":null},{"id":"refried-beans-s6","text":"Serve, and enjoy with some totopos.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Rice Pudding
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"rice-pudding-s0","text":"Wash the rice. Boil it till very soft. Drain it and set it away to get cold. Put the butter and sugar together in a pan, and stir them till very light. Add to them the spice and rose-water. Beat the eggs very light, and stir them, gradually, into the milk. Then stir the eggs and the milk into the butter and sugar, alternately with the rice.","groupId":null},{"id":"rice-pudding-s1","text":"Bake it and grate nutmeg over the top.","groupId":null},{"id":"rice-pudding-s2","text":"Currants or raisins, floured, and stirred in at the last, will greatly improve it. It should be eaten cold, or quite cool.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

Once the temperature has been reached, add the citric acid (or lemon juice) and stir well. You should already see the citric acid react with the milk/whey. Heat it up to 90°C Pour the ricotta in the cheesecloth and let the whey drip. Move the ricotta into the cheese recipient. recipes.name: Risengrød
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"risengroed-s0","text":"Bring water and rice to a boil in a deep pot. Boil the rice at steady heat and with active stirring for approximately 2 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"risengroed-s1","text":"Add milk and bring the concoction to a boil. Boil the pot at low heat, still with active stirring for approximately 10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"risengroed-s2","text":"Put on lid and boil for approximately 30 minutes. Stir the pot often. If the porridge seems too thin, boil it for another 5-10 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"risengroed-s3","text":"Add salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"risengroed-s4","text":"Mix sugar and cinnamon to form cinnamon sugar in a bowl or container.","groupId":null},{"id":"risengroed-s5","text":"Serve warm with cinnamon sugar on top and a bit of butter in the middle.","groupId":null},{"id":"risengroed-s6","text":"Enjoy!","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Rösti
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"roesti-s0","text":"Shred raw or cooked (but cool) potatoes with a grater. The shreds should be quite large so don't use your typical cheese shredder.","groupId":null},{"id":"roesti-s1","text":"Dice the first onion and mix together with potatoes. recipes.name: Sauerkraut

recipes.name: Sourdough bread with seeds and grains
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s0","text":"Feed your sourdough starter for the next day.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg0"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s1","text":"Boil the grain in 500g water for 45 minutes.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg0"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s2","text":"Put the seeds and 100g water into a bowl.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg0"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s3","text":"Store everything in a locked bowl overnight (13-16h).","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg0"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s4","text":"Remove leftover water from the seeds and grains","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s5","text":"Stir all ingredients for the bread and knead them well.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s6","text":"Let the dough rest for 5 hours in warm (25-30°C) conditions.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s7","text":"Preheat the oven to 250°C.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s8","text":"Bake for up to 20 minute with steam.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s9","text":"Release the steam and turn the heat down to 150°C.","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-s10","text":"Bake for another 50-60 minutes","groupId":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1"}],"groups":[{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg0","title":"Preparations (the day before)"},{"id":"sourdough-bread-with-seeds-and-grains-dg1","title":"Bread"}]}

recipes.name: Sourdough Table Loaf
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s0","text":"Combine sourdough starter with warm water, break apart and dissolve.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s1","text":"Add flour and mix together gently to hydrate. Mixture will be very wet and sticky.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s2","text":"Once there is no dry flour, let stand for 30 minutes (autolyze).","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s3","text":"Add sea salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s4","text":"Wet hands and begin to stretch and fold dough to combine salt and to begin gluten formation.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s5","text":"Add drops of water until dough becomes cohesive and supple with no toughness or resistance.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s6","text":"Dough will prove on the counter top for 4 - 5 hours. About every 30 minutes, perform a stretch and fold. This involves grabbing the dough with a wet hand, folding over the top of itself, and repeating this step by turning the bowl and making your way around the dough. It will take some practice to work with a dough of this level of hydration, but will get easier!","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s7","text":"You will know fermentation is complete when small bubbles are seen on the surface around the edge of your dough. You can also perform a window pane test by grasping a pinch of dough and pulling it between your fingers. The dough should stretch enough to become see-through. This means enough gluten has formed that the dough is strong enough to hold large air bubbles as it bakes.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s8","text":"Turn onto generously floured surface using a bowl scraper or spatula to protect the dough. Handling the dough gently will prevent deflation.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s9","text":"Shape the dough: Take the two sides and fold them into the center of the wet dough. Then, take the top and bottom and fold them also over the center of the wet dough. Optional: grasp the edge of the dough closest to you and roll dough away from you into a tight loaf shape. Generously flour.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s10","text":"Place into a dish about the size of the dough, a proving basket is ideal. Use a lot of flour in the bowl and on the loaf. The sides of the container should not be shallow, the goal here is to let the bread rest in the shape you want it to bake in.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s11","text":"Refrigerate 12 - 24 hours, the longer the dough rests, the more sour your final product. I don't recommend going over 24 hours but sour dough is fun to experiment with!","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s12","text":"Bring dough to room temperature, it should feel like a water balloon, giving resistance to touch with some spring.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s13","text":"Put one oven rack in the center and another below it, place a pan of water on the lower rack. Preheat oven to 475 - 500 degrees F, depending on oven capability. The pan of water should create steam to help the bread expand.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s14","text":"When oven is hot, turn bread into a baking vessel. I use a 8 inch springform pan, but a dutch oven is ideal. You can use any vessel that is rated for high temperatures. If using a dutch oven, keep it covered for the first 15 minutes, and you don't need to use the pan of water.","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s15","text":"Flour the top of the loaf and score the bread with a razor blade (this is optional but creates an artisan look)","groupId":null},{"id":"sourdough-loaf-s16","text":"Bake covered/steamed for 15 minutes, then reduce oven temperature to 425 F. (if you can wait!)","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spaghetti alla puttanesca
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s0","text":"Wash capers from salt, then cut them","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s1","text":"Pit and crush Gaeta olives","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s2","text":"Wash and chop the bunch of parsley","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s3","text":"Start cooking the pasta until al dente.","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s4","text":"Pour the oil, the peeled garlic cloves and the chopped dry chilli peppers into a large pan","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s5","text":"Add the anchovy fillets and capers","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s6","text":"Brown over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring often, so the anchovies will melt","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s7","text":"Now add peeled tomatoes \"sugo\"; mix it with a spoon and cook for another 10 minutes over medium heat","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s8","text":"When the sauce is ready, remove the garlic cloves","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s9","text":"Add crushed olives and chopped parsley","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s10","text":"Drain spaghetti directly in the pan and sauté it for half a minute","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-alla-puttanesca-s11","text":"The dish is ready","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s0","text":"Heat olive oil in a 4 to 5 quart pot on medium-high heat.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s1","text":"Add onions and cook for 2 minutes.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s2","text":"Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds longer or until fragrant.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s3","text":"Add the carrots and mushrooms, and cook for 2 minutes.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s4","text":"Add the tomato paste, stir to blend, and cook for a minute longer.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s5","text":"Add the canned tomatoes, basil, and parsley.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s6","text":"Mash and stir the tomatoes with a potato masher until the sauce starts to thicken, about 5 minutes over medium-high heat.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s7","text":"Reduce heat to low and simmer gently while preparing meatballs, stirring occasionally.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s8","text":"In a large bowl, mix by hand the beef, Italian sausage, basil, parsley, mushrooms, eggs, breadcrumbs, cheese, and 2 tablespoons of salt and pepper. Do not overmix or the meatballs will be tough.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg1"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s9","text":"Use small melon baller (or teaspoon) to form 1-inch round meatballs.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg1"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s10","text":"Roll and compress into tight balls.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg1"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s11","text":"In a separate wide, shallow pan, heat olive oil on medium-high heat.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg2"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s12","text":"Brown meatballs on all sides for about 2-3 minutes. Depending on the pan size, you may need to brown two batches of the meatballs. Cook them in a single layer; do not crowd the pan by stacking them. Do not overcook the meatballs; they will continue to cook in the sauce.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg2"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s13","text":"Towards the end of browning the meatballs, add a little bit of red wine to deglaze the pan.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg2"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s14","text":"Add the cheese and red wine to the sauce and stir it in. Add 1 teaspoon of salt to taste.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg3"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s15","text":"Add meatballs and gently stir. Simmer the sauce and meatballs for 30-45 minutes while cooking the spaghetti, stirring occasionally.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg3"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s16","text":"Cook the pasta and optionally add 0.333 cup of pasta water to the sauce.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg4"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-s17","text":"Place a thin layer of sauce on a plate. Add pasta, sauce and meatballs.","groupId":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg5"}],"groups":[{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg0","title":"Prepare the sauce"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg1","title":"Form the meatballs"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg2","title":"Cook the meatballs"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg3","title":"Finish and simmer the sauce"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg4","title":"Cook the spaghetti"},{"id":"spaghetti-and-meatballs-dg5","title":"Serve"}]}

If adding red pepper flakes add them now.","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-sauce-s3","text":"Cook uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.","groupId":null},{"id":"spaghetti-sauce-s4","text":"Add a pinch of salt, the remaining 0.25 cup of olive oil, and basil if you are adding that. \\n","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spanish Tortilla
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s0","text":"Peel, rinse and dry the potatoes.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s1","text":"Cut the potatoes into thin slices. Put in a bowl, add salt to taste and stir.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s2","text":"Put a nonstick frying pan on the fire and add enough olive oil to fry all the potato slices.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s3","text":"Add the potato slices already salted and let them cook for approximately 20 minutes over low heat.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s4","text":"While the potatoes are frying, beat the eggs in a bowl. Peel and cut the onion as finely as possible.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s5","text":"Add olive oil in another frying pan and slowly fry the onion until it gets a slightly golden color.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s6","text":"Drain the onion and add it to the bowl with the beaten egg.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s7","text":"Remove the potatoes from the pan with a slotted spoon, draining the oil away as much as possible, and add them to the bowl with the onion and egg.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s8","text":"Let the mixture rest for at least 5 minutes so all the flavors come together. Give it a very gentle stir from time to time.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s9","text":"Remove the oil from the pan you used to fry the potatoes. Use the pan to cook the mixture over medium-high fire for about 5 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"spanish-tortilla-s10","text":"Flip it over with the help of a big plate and cook the other side for another 5 minutes.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spatchcock Chicken
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spatchcock-chicken-s0","text":"Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil.","groupId":null},{"id":"spatchcock-chicken-s1","text":"Place chicken, breast side down, on a work surface. Starting at the tail end, cut along both sides of backbone with kitchen shears. Remove backbone. Grabbing hold of both sides of the chicken, open it like a book. Turn breast side up. Push down on each side of breast with your hands until you hear it crack. Flatten chicken and transfer to one short end of the prepared baking sheet. Repeat with the second chicken.","groupId":null},{"id":"spatchcock-chicken-s2","text":"Combine salt, tarragon, paprika, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir in oil. Run your fingers under chicken skin and rub tarragon paste under skin. Slide lemon slices under skin, in a single layer.","groupId":null},{"id":"spatchcock-chicken-s3","text":"Roast until skin is crisp and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast reads 165 degrees F, about 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting each chicken into 8 pieces.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spiced Apple Pancakes
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spiced-apple-pancakes-s0","text":"In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking powder, and 1 pinch of salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-apple-pancakes-s1","text":"Separate the egg yolk and egg white. Add the egg yolk to the dry ingredients.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-apple-pancakes-s2","text":"Whisk the egg white until foamy.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-apple-pancakes-s3","text":"Slice the peeled apple into thin strips. Alternatively, grate the apple.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-apple-pancakes-s4","text":"Combine dry ingredients, apple, vanilla extract, egg white, and milk into a homogenous batter.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-apple-pancakes-s5","text":"To a large pan, add 1 tbsp butter. Add the batter (about 3 tbsp per pancake) and cook for 2 min per side on medium-high heat.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spiced cantaloupe
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spiced-cantaloupe-s0","text":"Pare the cantaloupe, remove seeds and cut into strips, 1x2 inch or squares.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-cantaloupe-s1","text":"Dissolve the alum in the water and bring to a boil.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-cantaloupe-s2","text":"Add the cantaloupe and cook for 15 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-cantaloupe-s3","text":"Drain well.","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-cantaloupe-s4","text":"Combine vinegar, sugar and spices. Add the cantaloupe and simmer slowly until fruit is transparent (about 45 minutes).","groupId":null},{"id":"spiced-cantaloupe-s5","text":"Place in hot sterilized jars and seal.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spicy Kung Pao-Style Chicken
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spicy-kung-pao-style-chicken-s0","text":"Heat a medium pot over medium heat. Add 0.5 Tbsp oil, ginger and rice. Cook, stirring often, until fragrant (1 min). Add 1 0.25 cups water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and cover until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed (12-14 mins). Remove the pot from heat, leave covered.","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-kung-pao-style-chicken-s1","text":"While rice cooks, cut celery crosswise into 0.25\" slices. Whisk together soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, 0.333 cup water, and half the chili garlic sauce in a medium bowl. Combine flour and 0.25 tsp each of salt and pepper in another medium bowl.","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-kung-pao-style-chicken-s2","text":"Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add peanuts to the dry pan. Toast, stirring often, until golden brown (4-5 mins). Transfer to a plate and heat the same pan over medium-high. Add 0.5 Tbsp oil, peppers, and celery. Cook, stirring often until fragrant (1 min). Transfer veggies to another plate.","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-kung-pao-style-chicken-s3","text":"Pat chicken dry and cut into 1\" pieces. Add chicken to flour mixture, then toss to coat. Press flour mixture into chicken to coat completely. Heat the same non-stick pan over medium and add oil, then chicken. Cook, turning pieces occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through (6-8 mins).","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-kung-pao-style-chicken-s4","text":"Add veggies and sauce mixture to the pan with chicken. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly (2-3 mins).","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-kung-pao-style-chicken-s5","text":"Fluff rice with fork. Stir in half the green onions and season with salt. Divide rice between plates. Top with chicken, veggies, and sauce. Sprinkle peanuts and remaining green onions over top.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Spicy Sausage Pasta
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"spicy-sausage-pasta-s0","text":"Fry red onions with a splash of oil in a deep frying pan. Add the sausage meat (discarding the casings if need be). Add the rosemary and chilli","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-sausage-pasta-s1","text":"Increase the heat and break up the sausage meat with a wooden spoon. Once meat has browned, pour in red wine and reduce by half. Add the chopped tomatoes and reduce the sauce, uncovered, for about 30 mins. Cook the pasta according to packet instructions.","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-sausage-pasta-s2","text":"Grate the parmesan into a bowl. Drain the pasta and stir into the sauce with the parmesan, double cream and some seasoning.","groupId":null},{"id":"spicy-sausage-pasta-s3","text":"Serve :)","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

ingredients.name: A large glass of red wine

recipes.name: Spinach-Rice Casserole

Cook 2 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"spinach-rice-casserole-s1","text":"Combine with all ingredients except sunflower seeds and paprika.","groupId":null},{"id":"spinach-rice-casserole-s2","text":"Spread into buttered casserole dish and sprinkle sunflower seeds and paprika on top.","groupId":null},{"id":"spinach-rice-casserole-s3","text":"Bake, covered, 35 minutes at 350F.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Stoemp
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"stoemp-s0","text":"Cut bacon into bits.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoemp-s1","text":"Sauté bacon until well colored.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoemp-s2","text":"Peel and dice into small chunks potatoes, peel and slice carrots.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoemp-s3","text":"Boil for 20-25 minutes potatoes and carrots in salted water.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoemp-s4","text":"Drain vegetables and mash with a fork, so that the texture remains slightly chunky.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoemp-s5","text":"Mix with bacon bits, butter, cream, nutmeg, salt, pepper.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Stoofvlees
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"stoofvlees-s0","text":"Peel the onions and cut them into medium sized pieces, don't cut the onion too small.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s1","text":"Place a large saucepan or dutch oven on low heat and add 1 tbsp butter. Once melted add your onions, cook until translucent.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s2","text":"While your onions are cooking place a large frying pan on medium high heat and melt your second spoon of butter.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s3","text":"Fry up your beef until it has a nice brown crust, to prevent overcrowding the pan you should sear the meat in separate batches, be careful to not burn the fond on the bottom of the pan.season the meat with salt and pepper while its cooking.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s4","text":"When a piece of beef is done searing add it to the pot with the onions, once you're done searing all of your meat add your beer to the frying pan and use it to deglaze, scrape off all the pieces stuck to the frying pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s5","text":"Add the beer you used to deglaze to the pot with the onions and beef.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s6","text":"Add the bayleaf and thyme, optionally you can bind them together with some kitchen twine so they are easier to pick out later.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s7","text":"Add your clove and if you have it the syrup.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s8","text":"Take your piece of preferably brown bread and generously spread it with mustard on both sides, place it in the sauce.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s9","text":"let it simmer on low heat, stirring once every 10-15 minutes. when the sauce has reached your desired thickness place a lid on the pot.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s10","text":"The cooking time will depend on the quality of your meat, start checking the if your meat is done once its been simmering for about 2 hours.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s11","text":"The meat is done when the pieces hold together when gently stirring the sauce, but are easily cut with a fork or spoon.","groupId":null},{"id":"stoofvlees-s12","text":"Finish the sauce by gently stirring in the vinegar to brighten up the flavors and serve.","groupId":null}],"groups":[]}

recipes.name: Stracciatella soup

recipes.name: Stuffed Round Squash

In the meantime, cut the onion into small cubes, grate the carrot, and cut the squash in halves. Scoop the squash halves, and cut the core in small cubes. Save them for later.","groupId":null},{"id":"stuffed-round-squash-s1","text":"Strain the rice and let it cool. On an oiled pan, mix the onion, carrot and squash core, and cook them for 10 minutes. recipes.name: Stuffed vegetables
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"stuffed-vegetables-s0","text":"Cut all the vegetables in half on the long side. You may remove the seeds and some of the pulp from the tomato and the courgette, but not too much or you will get just burnt vegetable skin.","groupId":null},{"id":"stuffed-vegetables-s1","text":"Place the vegetables on baking paper in a baking tray.","groupId":null},{"id":"stuffed-vegetables-s2","text":"Sprinkle parsley over the vegetables, then, if you want, a little salt.","groupId":null},{"id":"stuffed-vegetables-s3","text":"Add copious grated bread, then sprinkle Parmigiano cheese all over it.","groupId":null},{"id":"stuffed-vegetables-s4","text":"Add enough olive oil to wet all the bread. recipes.name: Sunday Morning Milkshake

Usually I use about 6 tea spoons of sugar.","groupId":null},{"id":"sunday-milkshake-s2","text":"Pour enough milk so that the mix fills a liter of the blender volume.","groupId":null},{"id":"sunday-milkshake-s3","text":"Blend it until the mix looks somewhat homogeneous.","groupId":null},{"id":"sunday-milkshake-s4","text":"Pour it and enjoy!
