recipes.name: Swedish Pancakes
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"swedish-pancakes-s0","text":"At medium/low heat begin melting the butter, and continue with beating eggs in large bowl, add salt, sugar, milk, flour and mix.","groupId":null},{"id":"swedish-pancakes-s1","text":"Add melted butter while stirring batter.","groupId":null},{"id":"swedish-pancakes-s2","text":"Use about 0.5 cup batter on griddle and tilt until spread evenly over griddle surface.","groupId":null},{"id":"swedish-pancakes-s3","text":"When edges of pancake start to firm-up use spatula and free up the outside inch or two to achieve a clean removal for flipping later.","groupId":null},{"id":"swedish-pancakes-s4","text":"First side will take about a minute or more the second side will take half that time. recipes.name: Basic Sweet Potato Fries Recipe
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"sweet-potato-fries-s0","text":"Set oven heat to 425°F (220°C).","groupId":null},{"id":"sweet-potato-fries-s1","text":"Grab a pan and put a layer of parchment paper (or aluminum foil) on it.","groupId":null},{"id":"sweet-potato-fries-s2","text":"Chop the potato(es) on your cutting board with a sharp knife throwing them onto the pan.","groupId":null},{"id":"sweet-potato-fries-s3","text":"Drizzle the fries with olive oil. Toss the fries with clean hands to coat the fries in olive oil. Now wash your hands with soap to remove excess olive oil.","groupId":null},{"id":"sweet-potato-fries-s4","text":"Top generously with cinnamon and salt. Pepper and/or rosemary may be added for additional flavor if desired.","groupId":null},{"id":"sweet-potato-fries-s5","text":"Put in preheated oven. Setting timer for 20 minutes.","groupId":null},{"id":"sweet-potato-fries-s6","text":"At 20 minutes, flip the fries. recipes.name: Turkish-Style Spiced Chicken
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"turkish-style-spiced-chicken-s0","text":"Cut sweet potatoes into 0.5 inch pieces. Lay to a baking sheet and roast on the middle rack of the oven, stirring halfway through until golden brown (12-22 mins).","groupId":null},{"id":"turkish-style-spiced-chicken-s1","text":"While sweet potatoes roast, heat a medium pot over medium-high heat. When hot, add a tablespoon of oil and remaining onions. Cook, stirring often until fragrant (1 min). Add chicken broth and rice, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and leave covered until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed (12-14 mins). Remove pot from heat, still covered.","groupId":null},{"id":"turkish-style-spiced-chicken-s2","text":"While rice cooks, heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat. When hot, add almonds to the dry pan. Toast, stirring occasionally until golden brown (2-3 mins). When almonds are done, transfer to a plate and set aside.","groupId":null},{"id":"turkish-style-spiced-chicken-s3","text":"While almonds toast, pat chicken dry with paper towel. Sprinkle with Turkish Spice blend and the remaining garlic salt. Season with pepper. With the pan used in the last step, increase heat to medium-high. Add a tablespoon of oil and the chicken. Pan-fry until golden brown (1-2 min per side). Transfer chicken to another baking sheet. Roast on the top rack of the oven until chicken is cooked through (10-12 mins).","groupId":null},{"id":"turkish-style-spiced-chicken-s4","text":"While chicken roasts, zest and juice half the lemon. recipes.name: Tuscan Style Pork Roast
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s0","text":"Preheat oven to 275°F (135°C)","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s1","text":"Butterfly the roast by cutting into three parts by cutting into the side starting a third of the way up the roast. When you get to the end of the roast open it up and repeat for the remaining roast. You're opening it up like a pamphlet. Refer to the video linked above if you're confused.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s2","text":"Cover with plastic wrap and beat with meat mallet to pound the pork to an even levelness.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s3","text":"Mince garlic cloves(8) with the rosemary(2 Tbsp). Place into a cold pan with olive oil(0.333 cup) and zest of lemon(1). Keep lemon for later.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s4","text":"Bring to slow simmer on medium low heat for 2-3 minutes. Strain the herbs making sure to squeeze all excess oil. Reserve oil for later.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s5","text":"Add pancetta/bacon(4 oz) to food processor. Pulse a few times before adding the garlic/rosemary mixture. Process until a smooth paste forms.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s6","text":"Salt and pepper both sides of the roast before placing the roast fat side down and spreading the paste over the roast leaving about a 2 inch gap on one side.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s7","text":"Roll tightly towards the 2 inch gap and use butchers twine to secure the roll. Place a knot every inch or so.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s8","text":"Bake at 275°F (135°C) for 2 hours or until internal temperature reads 135°F (57°C) in the thickest part.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s9","text":"Add olive oil to cast iron skillet and heat on high until ripping hot. Cut remaining lemon in half. Brown all sides of pork roast and lemon using tongs.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s10","text":"Juice the lemon into the remaining oil from the garlic/rosemary herb spread. Add freshly chopped parsley. Whisk with fork until emulsified. Season with salt and pepper.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s11","text":"Slice roast into 0.5 inch thick slices and top with lemon herb vinaigrette.","groupId":null},{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-s12","text":"I point out that ingredients need to be fresh, the olive oil high quality, the salt needs to be kosher, and the pepper freshly ground not because I'm some rich snob but because it actually matters. The olive oil is one of the main flavors in this dish and it will taste significantly worse if you cheap out. Herbs, especially rosemary, don't even taste the same when comparing dried to fresh.","groupId":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-dg0"}],"groups":[{"id":"tuscan-style-pork-roast-dg0","title":"A note on ingredient snootiness"}]}

recipes.name: Ukrainian Borscht

Continue adding broth 1 cup at a time, stirring regularly, until liquid is absorbed, the texture is creamy and the rice is tender (28-30 mins).","groupId":null},{"id":"winter-risotto-s3","text":"While risotto cooks, add tomatoes and a tablespoon of oil to a parchment-lined baking sheet. recipes.name: Za'atar Chicken Bulghur Bowls

recipes.name: Zarangollo

recipes.name: Zopf
recipes.instructions: {"steps":[{"id":"zopf-s0","text":"Cut or tear up butter and put in skillet with milk on low heat (This is so the ingredients are not too clod, temperature should not exceed 31 C).","groupId":null},{"id":"zopf-s1","text":"Put the flour in a large bow with the yeast, salt, milk and butter.","groupId":null},{"id":"zopf-s2","text":"Mix and kneed for at least 15 minutes making sure to stretch the dough a lot.","groupId":null},{"id":"zopf-s3","text":"Let the dough rest in a warm spot for at least one hour (temperature should not be higher than 31 C).","groupId":null},{"id":"zopf-s4","text":"Start heating an oven at 200 C (no need to preheat, it will be a good temperature once you are done braiding)","groupId":null},{"id":"zopf-s5","text":"Cut the dough in two or three sections (different according to region), then stretch and roll into long pieces.","groupId":null},{"id":"zopf-s6","text":"Braid the strips, place on a parchment lined baking sheet and brush down with a beaten egg.","groupId":null},{"id":"zopf-s7","text":"Bake for 30 minutes testing with a wooden skewer in the widest part when done.
